09生育介入與西醫生殖醫學路徑Fertility Interventions & the Biomedical Fertility Pathway

9.1不孕歷程與生殖診所轉介流程The Infertility Journey & Referral to the Fertility Clinic

不孕歷程流程圖Infertility Journey — Flowchart
English必記

The course's own flowchart traces the pathway as follows:

  • Referral to Fertility Clinic →
  • Consultation with Specialist →
  • Cycle Monitoring, running across one monitored cycle:
    • Cycle Day 3 — Blood and Ultrasound (AMH, FSH, Estrogen, Progesterone, LH; Antral Follicle Count, Lining)
    • Cycle Day 9 — Sonohysterogram / HSG
    • Cycle Day 11–14 — Blood (LH) and Ultrasound
    • Cycle Day 21 — Blood (Progesterone)
  • → Consultation with Specialist, leading to one of three paths:
    • Timed Intercourse with Cycle Monitoring
    • Medicated IUI
    • IVF
中文必記

課程原文流程圖所示路徑如下：

  • 轉介至生殖診所 →
  • 與專科醫師會診 →
  • 週期監測，於同一個受監測週期內進行：
    • 週期第3天——抽血與超音波檢查（AMH、FSH、雌激素、黃體素、LH；基礎濾泡數、內膜厚度）
    • 週期第9天——子宮腔超音波攝影或輸卵管攝影
    • 週期第11–14天——抽血檢查LH與超音波
    • 週期第21天——抽血檢查黃體素
  • → 與專科醫師會診，之後導向三種路徑之一：
    • 週期監測配合同房
    • 服藥人工受精
    • 試管嬰兒（IVF）
起始三步驟The Initial Three Steps
English必記
  1. Patient has been trying for 6 months to a year and has been unsuccessful in conceiving.
  2. They will speak to their family physician to obtain a referral to a fertility clinic.
  3. Fertility clinic consult with physician will result in an initial Cycle Monitoring Cycle, including:
    • Blood work — FSH, Estrogen, LH, Prolactin, TSH, AMH, sexually transmitted diseases.
    • Ultrasound.
    • Sono Hysterogram.
    • Sperm Analysis.
中文必記
  1. 病患嘗試懷孕6個月至1年仍未成功。
  2. 與家庭醫師討論並取得轉介至生殖診所。
  3. 生殖診所與醫師會診後，會安排初始週期監測，包含：
    • 抽血——FSH、雌激素、LH、泌乳激素、TSH、AMH、性傳染疾病。
    • 超音波。
    • 子宮腔攝影。
    • 精液分析。
〈說明：上列「起始三步驟」所列之抽血項目（FSH、雌激素、LH、泌乳激素、TSH、AMH、性傳染疾病、精液分析）與前一段「週期監測時間表」所列之逐日檢查項目（第3天：AMH、FSH、雌激素、黃體素、LH、基礎濾泡數、內膜厚度）為原文中兩種不同角度的並列陳述——前者依「檢查類別」列出整體項目，後者依「週期天數」列出時間安排，兩者部分重疊（FSH／雌激素／LH／AMH）但亦各自包含對方沒有的項目（前者多出泌乳激素、TSH、性病篩檢、精液分析；後者則標明黃體素、基礎濾泡數、內膜厚度及第9、11–14、21天等具體時間點）。原文本身即以此兩種方式並列陳述，本模組如實保留兩段內容，未合併簡化，以免遺漏原文任一版本的細節。〉

9.2生物醫學分析——血液檢查與影像檢查Biomedical Analysis — Bloodwork & Imaging

第3天抽血：常見參考值Day-3 Bloodwork — Common Reference Levels
〈說明：原始 pdftotext 擷取版本在此處僅留下「於週期第3天抽血 常見數值為」一句，後方的數值表格本身即為 PDF 中的圖片式表格，未能被文字擷取工具取出（與 Module 8 遇到的技術性缺口相同）。本模組已直接以 pdftoppm 將來源 PDF（Gynaecology_9_Fertility_Interventions_生育介入.pdf）第2頁轉為圖片並目視確認，成功還原下表數值，並非憑空杜撰或未經查證地沿用其他模組資料。核對後發現：此處親自確認之數值與 Module 8 先前依「8-2_Female Fertility In person Class notes.pptx」簡報第13張投影片交叉參考之數值，在 FSH 與 TSH 兩項略有出入（FSH：本模組原文為「低於12 mIU」，Module 8 簡報來源為「低於9 mIU」；TSH：本模組原文為「0.4–3 mU/L」，Module 8 簡報來源為「0.4–4 mU/L」），其餘四項（Estrogen、LH、Prolactin、AMH）數值相同。此差異可能反映兩份原始教材（PDF 講義 vs. 面授筆記簡報）於不同時間點或不同版本使用之參考值略有更新，本模組不擅自「校正」或合併兩者，僅如實呈現本模組自身來源 PDF 所示之數值，並於此處誠實揭露此一跨模組數值差異，供讀者自行留意。〉
English必記

Taken on day 3 of the cycle, common levels are:

  • FSH — less than 12 mIU is normal.
  • Estrogen — 25–75 pg/mL.
  • LH — 3–10 mIU/mL.
  • Prolactin — less than 25 ng/mL.
  • TSH — 0.4–3 mU/L.
  • AMH — under 1.5 is very low.
中文必記

於週期第3天抽血，常見數值為：

  • FSH——低於12 mIU為正常。
  • 雌激素——25–75 pg/mL。
  • LH——3–10 mIU/mL。
  • 泌乳激素——低於25 ng/mL。
  • TSH——0.4–3 mU/L。
  • AMH——低於1.5屬非常低。
超音波與子宮腔超音波攝影Ultrasound & Sonohysterogram
English必記
  • Ultrasound — looking for uterine abnormalities, antral follicle counts, lining thickness.
  • Sonohysterogram — saline is injected into the uterus while an ultrasound is performed. It is used to look for polyps, fibroids and other uterine abnormalities.
  • Hysterosalpingogram (HSG) — dye is injected into the uterus, along with imaging, to look for anatomic problems such as tube patency (how open the fallopian tubes are), fibroids, polyps, or structural problems with the uterine cavity.
中文必記
  • 超音波——檢查子宮異常、基礎濾泡數、內膜厚度。
  • 子宮腔超音波攝影——進行超音波時將生理食鹽水注入子宮內，用於檢查息肉、肌瘤及其他子宮異常。
  • 輸卵管攝影（HSG）——將顯影劑注入子宮，配合影像檢查，以觀察解剖問題，如輸卵管通暢度、肌瘤、息肉，或子宮腔結構異常。
〈考點提醒：子宮腔超音波攝影（Sonohysterogram）與輸卵管攝影（HSG）最容易混淆之處，在於注入子宮的介質不同——前者為生理食鹽水，後者為顯影劑；且「輸卵管通暢度」是 HSG 的觀察重點，並非 Sonohysterogram 的主要目的。此區分正是本模組 9.9 節 Quiz 4 Q4 的出題重點，請務必留意。〉

9.3基礎解剖與卵子－囊胚之旅（回顧）Basic Anatomy & the Ovum → Blastocyst Journey (Recap)

〈說明：本模組來源 PDF 在此處（Basic Anatomy 一節）逐句重複了與 Module 8 §8.1「基礎解剖與卵子－囊胚之旅」完全相同的英文＋中文內容（濾泡在FSH影響下生長、LH高峰後24–36小時排卵、黃體分泌黃體素、受精卵5–7天沿輸卵管移動、囊胚著床等段落逐字相同），並附上與 Module 8 完全相同的「女性生殖系統解剖圖」（本模組 image1.jpg 與 Module 8 anatomy 圖檔案雜湊值 md5 完全一致，確認為同一圖檔）及「Ovum → Blastocyst Journey」卵子－囊胚旅程圖（本模組 image7.png 雖檔案格式與裁切不同，但目視比對後確認為同一張示意圖，僅多了「Ovum -> Blastocyst journey」標題文字）。依本專案「Module 3／5／6 已建立之不重複收錄慣例」，此處不再逐句重列已收錄於 Module 8 的內容與圖片，僅以下方摘要段落標示本節在原文中的位置與要點，並連結回 Module 8 §8.1 供讀者查閱完整雙語內容與圖片。此為刻意之不重複收錄，而非遺漏。〉
English

The course revisits the same physiological groundwork here — follicle growth under FSH, the LH-surge-triggered ovulation window, corpus luteum progesterone secretion, and blastocyst implantation — before turning to the biomedical interventions that are this module's actual new content. Full bilingual text, the two accompanying figures (reproductive anatomy diagram; Ovum → Blastocyst Journey diagram), and the "must-know" summary points are found at Module 8, §8.1 — Basic Anatomy & the Ovum → Blastocyst Journey.

中文

課程在此處再次複習相同的生理學基礎——FSH影響下的濾泡生長、LH高峰觸發的排卵窗口、黃體分泌黃體素、囊胚著床——之後才進入本模組真正的新內容：生物醫學介入。完整雙語內文、兩張附圖（生殖系統解剖圖；卵子－囊胚旅程圖）及「必記」重點，請見 Module 8 §8.1 基礎解剖與卵子－囊胚之旅。

9.4子宮內人工受精（IUI）與精子洗滌Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) & Sperm Wash

子宮內人工受精Intrauterine Insemination (IUI)
English必記
  • The IUI procedure is performed around the time of ovulation.
  • A semen sample will be washed by the lab to separate the semen from the seminal fluid.
  • A catheter will then be used to insert the sperm directly into the uterus. This process maximizes the number of sperm cells that are placed in the uterus, thus increasing the possibility of conception.
中文必記
  • IUI 手術於排卵期前後進行。
  • 精液樣本會在實驗室清洗，以分離精子與精液。
  • 使用導管將精子直接置入子宮，此過程最大化置入子宮的精子數量，增加受孕機率。
精子洗滌Sperm Wash
English必記
  1. The sperm washing process facilitates the segregation of motile sperm from immotile sperm, dead sperm and seminal fluid.
  2. After a semen sample is collected, the sperm liquefies for approximately 20 minutes on a warmer.
  3. The semen is placed in a test tube, on top of two liquids with different densities (called a "gradient"), which will act as a filtering system. (Per the course slide deck: the top gradient is less concentrated than the lower gradient.)
  4. The semen and gradients are then centrifuged, causing the seminal fluid to be trapped in the top layer, non-motile sperm in the middle layer, and motile sperm in a pellet at the bottom.
  5. The pellet of motile sperm is re-suspended in another liquid media, and the concentration, motility and progression of the sperm are evaluated.
  6. The sample is then ready for IUI, IVF or IVF with ICSI.
中文必記
  1. 精子洗滌過程可分離活動精子與不活動精子、死精及精液。
  2. 收集精液後，於加溫器上液化約20分鐘。
  3. 將精液置於試管中，上方覆蓋兩層不同密度液體（稱為「梯度」），作為過濾系統。（依課程簡報：上層梯度濃度低於下層梯度。）
  4. 精液與梯度液經離心後，精液停留於上層，不活動精子於中層，活動精子沉澱於底部形成精子丸。
  5. 活動精子沉澱再懸浮於另一培養液中，並評估濃度、活動度與前進性。
  6. 樣本隨後可用於IUI、IVF或IVF併用ICSI。

9.5體外受精（IVF）：週期天數方案In Vitro Fertilization (IVF): Cycle-Day Protocol

English必記

During IVF, mature eggs are retrieved from the ovaries and fertilized by sperm in a lab. Then the fertilized embryo(s) are transferred to the uterus.

  1. Cycle Day 1 — Call in to the clinic.
  2. Cycle Day 3 — Start injectable medications to stimulate ovaries to mature multiple follicles.
  3. Cycle Day 4–12 (14) — Continue injectable medications; take medications to stop ovulation.
  4. 48 hours before retrieval — Take medication to induce ovulation.
  5. Retrieval of eggs from follicles.
  6. Eggs are fertilized.
  7. Fertilized embryos grow until Day 5 (Blastocyst).

The source also lists a Retrieval Procedure step (illustrated below) and an ICSI step — the source gives the name "ICSI" only, with a micrograph image, and no further elaboration in text. The final step listed is the Ovum → Blastocyst Journey — the same journey covered in Module 8 §8.1 and §9.3 above; not repeated here.

中文必記

IVF過程中，從卵巢取出成熟卵子，於實驗室中由精子受精，再將受精胚胎移植回子宮。

  1. 週期第1天——致電診所。
  2. 週期第3天——開始注射藥物，刺激卵巢成熟多顆濾泡。
  3. 週期第4至12（或14）天——持續注射藥物，並服用抑制排卵藥物。
  4. 取卵前48小時——服用誘發排卵藥物。
  5. 從濾泡中取卵。
  6. 卵子受精。
  7. 受精胚胎培養至第5天（囊胚）。

原文接著列出「取卵手術（Retrieval Procedure）」步驟（附圖如下）及「ICSI」步驟——原文僅列出「ICSI」名稱並附一張顯微注射照片，內文未進一步說明。最後列出「卵子→囊胚旅程（Ovum → Blastocyst Journey）」，與 Module 8 §8.1 及本模組 9.3 節所述為同一旅程，此處不再重複列出。

9.6中醫在IUI中的角色TCM Role in IUI

〈說明：來源 PDF 於此處實際以「Biomedical Intervention（生物醫學介入時點）／TCM Support（中醫支持）」兩欄表格呈現本節內容（已以 pdftoppm 目視確認），pdftotext 純文字擷取版本則將其攤平為條列文字，兩者內容一致，僅呈現形式不同。本模組下方以雙語 pair 呈現逐句內容，並於 9.9 節下方「Module 9 比較表」中，另以表格形式重新彙整本節與 9.7 節之時機對照，以貼近原文之表格呈現方式。〉
English必記
  • 3 months prior to procedure(s) — Acupuncture and herbs to support egg health, 1×/week.
  • IUI: Follicular Phase — Acupuncture/Herbs to nourish follicles, improve blood flow into the uterus, calm the mind, 1–2×/week.
  • IUI: Day of Insemination — Acupuncture to promote blood flow into the uterus and calm the mind.
  • IUI: 5 days post-insemination — Acupuncture to support implantation; raise Yang, nourish Yin and Blood, hold pregnancy.
  • IUI: Prior to pregnancy test — Acupuncture/Herbs to hold pregnancy, raise Yang, nourish Yin and Blood, 1×/week.
中文必記
  • 手術前三個月——針灸與中藥支持卵子健康，每週一次。
  • IUI濾泡期——針灸與中藥滋養濾泡、改善子宮血流、安神，每週1至2次。
  • IUI當天（授精日）——針灸促進子宮血流並安神。
  • IUI後5天——針灸支持著床；升陽，養陰養血，固攝妊娠。
  • 懷孕測試前——針灸與中藥固攝妊娠、升陽、養陰養血，每週一次。

9.7中醫在IVF中的角色TCM Role in IVF

English必記
  • 3 months prior to procedure(s) — Acupuncture and herbs to support egg health, 1×/week (same as IUI).
  • IVF: Follicular Phase — Acupuncture to nourish follicles, improve blood flow into the uterus, calm the mind, 1–3×/week.
  • IVF: Day before retrieval — Acupuncture to nourish follicles, calm the mind, improve uterine blood flow.
  • IVF: Wait for embryos to grow to blastocyst — No treatment during this time.
  • IVF: If Fresh Embryo Transfer — Acupuncture pre- and post-transfer; drive blood flow into the uterus, calm the mind.
  • IVF: If Frozen Embryo Transfer — Prepare uterine lining for thickness/receptivity, 4–6 weeks prior, acupuncture 2×/week with electro-stimulation.
  • IVF: Day of Transfer — Acupuncture pre- and post-transfer.
中文必記
  • 手術前三個月——針灸與中藥支持卵子健康，每週一次（與IUI相同）。
  • IVF濾泡期——針灸滋養濾泡、改善子宮血流、安神，每週1至3次。
  • 取卵前一天——針灸滋養濾泡、安神、改善子宮血流。
  • 等待胚胎培養至囊胚期間——此期間不治療。
  • 新鮮胚胎移植——於移植前後針灸；促進子宮血流並安神。
  • 冷凍胚胎移植——提前4至6週準備子宮內膜厚度與容受性，針灸每週2次配合電刺激。
  • 移植當天——移植前後針灸。

Module 9 Exam Focus 考點整理 · based on CTCMPAO question patterns

依你提供的 1000 題題庫（q1000，共 946 題）以關鍵字比對：IUI、IVF、sonohysterogram、HSG、intrauterine insemination、sperm wash、in vitro fertilization、ICSI、人工受精、試管、子宮腔攝影、輸卵管攝影、週期監測、生殖診所、精子洗滌、cycle monitoring、AMH、FSH、TSH、prolactin 等，比對結果為零命中——題庫中沒有任何一題直接考「IUI／IVF 操作步驟」「Sonohysterogram 與 HSG 之區別」「週期監測逐日時間表」等本模組核心之西醫生殖醫學路徑細節。（廣義的「infertil／不孕／clinic／conceive」等關鍵字則命中約 40 題，但這些幾乎全為中醫辨證案例題——如題號 Q40、Q143、Q447、Q568、Q841、Q923——與 Module 8「女性生育（中醫證型）」高度重疊，已由 Module 8 之 Exam Focus 收錄，此處不重複列出，以免混淆本模組真正的西醫生殖醫學路徑重點。）此一結果顯示：本模組之程序性內容（IUI／IVF流程、影像檢查區別等）主要透過課程自身之 Quiz 4（本模組 9.9 節已收錄其中兩題）測驗，而非透過 1000 題題庫測驗。以下考點依本模組內文邏輯整理，並非題庫原文照抄。
  • 轉介的啟動門檻：6個月至1年 Referral trigger — 6 months to 1 year：與 Module 8 §8.2 之不孕症定義（35歲以下1年／35歲以上6個月）相互呼應，本模組流程圖之啟動點為「嘗試6個月至1年未成功」，兩者為同一臨床判斷邏輯之不同表述，案例題常以此數字判斷病患是否已達轉介標準。
  • Sonohysterogram vs. HSG：食鹽水 vs. 顯影劑 Sonohysterogram (saline) vs. HSG (dye) — the classic mix-up：兩者皆為「注入某液體＋影像檢查」，最常見誤答是把兩者角色對調——子宮腔超音波攝影（Sonohysterogram）注入生理食鹽水，檢查息肉／肌瘤／子宮異常；輸卵管攝影（HSG）注入顯影劑，檢查輸卵管通暢度。本模組 9.9 節 Quiz 4 Q4 即以此設陷。
  • 週期監測時間表的四個節點 The four cycle-monitoring checkpoints：第3天（抽血＋超音波，含AMH／FSH／雌激素／黃體素／LH／基礎濾泡數／內膜厚度）、第9天（子宮腔超音波攝影或輸卵管攝影）、第11–14天（抽血LH＋超音波，對應排卵窗口）、第21天（抽血黃體素，對應排卵後黃體功能）——需能將檢查項目與其對應之週期天數配對。
  • IUI vs. IVF 的核心差異 IUI vs. IVF — the core distinction：IUI 是將洗滌後的精子以導管直接置入子宮，受精仍在體內（子宮／輸卵管）發生；IVF 則是先取卵，於體外（實驗室）完成受精與胚胎培養至第5天囊胚，再將胚胎移植回子宮——受精場所（體內 vs. 體外）是兩者最本質的差異。
  • IVF 週期天數方案 IVF cycle-day protocol：第1天致電診所 → 第3天開始注射藥物刺激濾泡 → 第4至12（或14）天持續注射並服藥「抑制」排卵 → 取卵前48小時服藥「誘發」排卵（觸發針）→ 取卵 → 受精 → 培養至第5天囊胚。「抑制排卵」與「誘發排卵」兩種藥物在同一方案中先後出現，方向相反，是常見的細節陷阱。
  • 精子洗滌的分層原理 Sperm wash — the density-gradient layers：離心後由上而下依序為「精液（頂層）→ 不活動精子（中層）→ 活動精子（底部，形成精子丸）」，此分層順序常以配對或排序題型出現。
  • 中醫介入 IUI 與 IVF 的時機差異 TCM timing differs between IUI and IVF：兩者手術前三個月的介入完全相同（每週一次支持卵子健康），但濾泡期頻率不同（IUI每週1–2次，IVF每週1–3次）；IVF特有「等待胚胎培養至囊胚期間不治療」及「冷凍胚胎移植須提前4–6週、每週2次配合電刺激準備內膜」兩項在IUI中不存在，是兩節內容中最易混淆的差異點。
  • 孕期支持的頻率遞減規律 Pregnancy-support frequency tapers over time：第一孕期每週一次 → 之後每個孕期一次 → 37週後回診支持分娩，此「愈到孕後期回診愈疏、但37週後再度回診」的規律，是本節最容易被誤記成單純遞減、忽略37週後回升的一點。

Q4原 Quiz 4 Q4（是非題）

True or False? "Sonohysterogram: Utilizes dye injected into the uterus, along with ultrasound to look for anatomic problems, such as tube patency."

是非題：「子宮腔超音波攝影（Sonohysterogram）：將顯影劑注入子宮，配合超音波檢查解剖問題，例如輸卵管通暢度。」此敘述正確嗎？

正解為「錯誤（False）」，此題原始得分即為滿分 1/1。此敘述描述的其實是輸卵管攝影（HSG）而非子宮腔超音波攝影（Sonohysterogram）：依本模組 9.2 節，HSG 才是「注入顯影劑（dye）＋檢查輸卵管通暢度」；Sonohysterogram 注入的是生理食鹽水（saline），主要用於檢查息肉、肌瘤及其他子宮異常，並非以輸卵管通暢度為主要檢查目的。此題是刻意將兩種檢查的敘述互換以設陷的經典考法。
The correct answer is False. This description actually matches the Hysterosalpingogram (HSG), not the Sonohysterogram: per §9.2, HSG is the one that injects dye and checks tube patency, while a Sonohysterogram injects saline and is mainly used to look for polyps, fibroids and other uterine abnormalities — not primarily tube patency. This is a classic trap that swaps the descriptions of the two procedures.
Q8原 Quiz 4 Q8（申論改寫）

A patient is trying to conceive for just over a year. Please specify her most appropriate next steps to guide her through the biomedical fertility pathway — what should she do next, and what should she expect moving forward?

病患嘗試懷孕剛滿一年。請說明帶領她進入西醫生殖醫學路徑最適切的下一步，她接下來應該採取什麼行動，以及後續應預期什麼？

正解為選項 A，與你本人原始提交之作答（1. 轉介家庭醫師 2. 轉介生殖診所 3. 初始週期監測：抽血FSH、LH、雌激素、AMH、超音波、精液檢查 4. 介入措施：藥物、荷爾蒙刺激、IUI、IVF）完全相符，此題原始得分為滿分 4/4，批改註記為「Excellent」。選項 B、D 皆為「跳過週期監測、直接進入IUI／IVF」之常見陷阱——依本模組 9.1 節流程圖，家庭醫師轉介與生殖診所之初始週期監測為必經步驟，不可省略；選項 C 則將轉介順序顛倒（原文流程為先經家庭醫師轉介至生殖診所，並非病患自行於原診所開始週期監測），用作鑑別「步驟順序錯誤」之干擾選項。〈補充說明：原始批改逐字稿中另有一行「1.delayed ovulation and thin endometrial lining and light bleed」，經核對批改格式後確認該行實為第1題（血虛週期申論題，已收錄於 Module 8）的批改註記，與本題（第8題）內容無關，特此註明以免誤植為本題答案的一部分。〉
The correct answer is A, matching your original submitted answer exactly — this item scored a full 4/4 with the grader's note "Excellent." Options B and D are the common trap of skipping cycle monitoring and jumping straight to IUI/IVF, which §9.1's flowchart does not allow. Option C reverses the referral order (the source has the family-doctor referral come before fertility-clinic cycle monitoring, not a patient starting monitoring on her own). 10男科學－生物醫學與中醫基礎Andrology — Biomedical & TCM Foundations

10.1泌尿生殖解剖Urogenital Anatomy

English必記

This module is the study of conditions of the male reproductive system and urological issues unique to men.

  • Take note of the location of the prostate gland — both the ejaculatory duct and the urethra run through it.
  • The pink area that the urethra runs through is the corpus spongiosum — the "spongy body." It fills with blood during an erection and keeps the urethra open.
  • The purple area is the corpus cavernosum — it fills with blood to cause an erection.
中文必記

本模組研究男性生殖系統相關疾病及男性特有之泌尿系統問題。

  • 注意前列腺的位置——射精管與尿道皆通過其中。
  • 尿道通過之粉紅色區域為尿道海綿體（corpus spongiosum）——勃起時充血，並保持尿道開放。
  • 紫色區域為陰莖海綿體（corpus cavernosum）——充血以產生勃起。

10.2中醫臟腑系統與男科學TCM Organ Systems & Andrology

English必記
  • Heart 心 — governs Blood, governs Spirit. Heart governing Spirit is essential to the vigor of men.
  • Spleen 脾 — governs the movement and transformation of water; is the source of post-Heaven Qi. Regular movement of fluids is relevant to urogenital issues, and post-Heaven Qi supports and replenishes Kidney Essence.
  • Liver 肝 — governs free flow in the Liver channel; ample Blood is stored in the Liver. The Liver channel runs through the genitals — normal function of the penis, scrotum and testes requires exuberant Blood.
  • Kidney 腎 — Qi seals and stores; houses Essence. Blood nourishes the whole body, including the reproductive organs, sexual tissues and urinary tissues. Kidney sealing and storing is essential for normal ejaculation. Essence governs reproductive maturation as well as forming the substance of ejaculate.
中文必記
  • 心——主血，主神。心主神明對男性精力至關重要。
  • 脾——主水液運化，為後天之氣之源。水液運行之規律與泌尿生殖問題相關，後天之氣支持並補充腎精。
  • 肝——肝主疏泄，肝經循行通暢；肝藏血充足。肝經循行經過生殖器——陰莖、陰囊與睪丸之正常功能，需要充足之血。
  • 腎——氣封藏，藏精。血滋養全身，包括生殖器官、性組織與泌尿組織。腎主封藏，對正常射精十分重要。精主生殖成熟，並構成精液之物質。

10.3腎精與男性八年週期Kidney Essence & the Male 8-Year Cycle

English必記

  • Basis of Kidney Qi; makes up the substance of ejaculate.
  • Essence flows in 8-year cycles. The source presents two parallel progressions across the same eight checkpoints — a Kidney-energy/Su Wen progression and a corresponding physical-development progression (see table below).

  • 決定生長、發育、生殖成熟與生育能力。
  • 為腎氣之本；構成精液之物質。
  • 精以八年為週期運行。原文於同一組八個年齡節點下，並列呈現兩種進程——腎氣（《素問》）進程與對應之身體發育進程（詳見下表）。

10.4泌尿生殖疾病概覽與慢性前列腺炎中醫辨證Urogenital Conditions Overview & Chronic Prostatitis — TCM Patterns

泌尿生殖疾病概覽Urogenital Conditions — Overview
English必記

The course lists five urogenital conditions of focus: prostatitis, benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), ischuria (urinary retention), erectile dysfunction, and seminal emission.

Prostatitis is inflammation of the prostate gland. Acute prostatitis is generally due to bacterial infection; chronic prostatitis may or may not be bacterial. Because the urethra passes through the prostate, swelling can interfere with urination. This course focuses care on chronic prostatitis — Western treatment is often unsatisfactory or non-existent for chronic prostatitis, and these are the clients we are likely to see.

中文必記

課程列出五項重點泌尿生殖疾病：前列腺炎、良性前列腺增生（BPH）、尿瀦留、勃起功能障礙與遺精。

前列腺炎為前列腺發炎。急性前列腺炎通常為細菌感染所致；慢性前列腺炎可能為細菌感染，也可能不是。由於尿道穿過前列腺，腫脹會干擾排尿。本課程將重點關注慢性前列腺炎——西醫對慢性前列腺炎的治療常常效果不佳或沒有治療，因此這類患者較常尋求中醫治療。

慢性前列腺炎——中醫辨證分型Chronic Prostatitis — TCM Patterns
English必記

The source names four patterns of chronic prostatitis:

  • Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis 氣滯血瘀
  • Turbid Dampness pouring downward 濁濕下注
  • Kidney Yin deficiency 腎陰虛
  • Kidney Yang deficiency 腎陽虛

All four patterns are given full detail in the source (course slide deck). The first two (Qi Stagnation/Blood Stasis, Turbid Dampness) are detailed immediately below; the chronic-prostatitis-specific Kidney Yin and Kidney Yang deficiency patterns are detailed further below in this same section as well, each with its own signs/symptoms, tongue, pulse, treatment principle, acupuncture and formula. These are distinct from — though related to — the differently-worded Kidney Yin/Kidney Yang deficiency patterns given for BPH in §10.5; the two sets of patterns are not the same content repeated.

中文必記

原文列出慢性前列腺炎四種辨證分型：

  • 氣滯血瘀
  • 濁濕下注
  • 腎陰虛
  • 腎陽虛

原文（課程投影片）對四種證型皆有完整說明。前兩型（氣滯血瘀、濁濕下注）詳見緊接於下方之段落；慢性前列腺炎專屬之腎陰虛與腎陽虛證型，本節下方亦另有完整說明，各附症狀體徵、舌象、脈象、治療原則、針灸穴位與方劑。此二證型與§10.5 BPH之腎陰虛／腎陽虛證型（症狀描述不同）為各自獨立之內容，並非同一段落之重複引用。

氣滯血瘀證Qi Stagnation & Blood Stasis
English必記

Signs and symptoms: lower abdominal pain, lower back pain, perineal and testicular pain, painful prostate.

Tongue: purplish. Pulse: wiry, tight.

Treatment Principle: Move Qi, Move Blood, Stop Pain.

Acupuncture: LR 3, LI 4, CV 3, CV 1, BL 54, SP 10, BL 17.

Formula: Qian Li Xian Tang (Prostate Decoction) — invigorates Blood: Dan Shen, Chi Shao, Hong Hua, Tao Ren, Ze Lan, Wang Bu Liu Xing, Chuan Shan Jia, Mo Yao; promotes Qi circulation: Chuan Lian Zi; clears Heat & resolves Dampness: Bai Zhi, Pu Gong Ying, Bai Jian Cao, Shi Wei; nourishes Liver/Kidney Blood & Yin: Gou Qi Zi.

中文必記

症狀與體徵：下腹痛、腰痛、會陰與睪丸疼痛、前列腺疼痛。

舌：舌紫。脈：脈弦緊。

治療原則：行氣、活血、止痛。

針灸：太衝、合谷、中極、會陰、秩邊、血海、膈俞。

方劑：千金仙湯（Qian Li Xian Tang，Prostate Decoction）——活血：丹參、赤芍、紅花、桃仁、澤蘭、王不留行、穿山甲、沒藥；行氣：川楝子；清熱利濕：白芷、蒲公英、敗醬草、石韋；滋補肝腎陰血：枸杞子。

〈勘誤：本節先前版本誤稱「原文本節未提及具體方劑名稱」——經重新比對來源簡報文字擷取檔案（10 - Andrology.pptx，投影片13）確認，原文確有明確列出方劑名稱與完整藥物組成，已據以更正並補充於上方。本模組11.2節 Quiz 5 第2題考核方中何組藥物具活血作用，正解王不留行、穿山甲、桃仁與投影片筆記中明確標示為「活血」（Invigorates Blood）之藥物群組（丹參至沒藥共八味，含此三味）完全對應，故此題正解現已可逐字追溯至原始投影片內容，不再僅為藥性歸類推論。〉
濁濕下注證Turbid Dampness Pouring Downward
English必記

Signs and symptoms: cloudy, turbid urine; whitish discharge; no pain or discomfort during urination.

Tongue: pale red, wet coat. Pulse: slippery, soggy.

Treatment Principles: Dry Dampness, Drain Turbidity.

Acupuncture: SP 9, ST 40, CV 3, GB 26, ST 25, ST 28, SJ 6.

Formula: Er Chen Tang Modified (Modified Decoction of Two Old Herbs) — the classic four-herb base (Fa Ban Xia, Chen Pi, Fu Ling, Zhi Gan Cao), plus Bei Xie (resolves turbid dampness in the lower jiao), Bai Hua She She Cao (clears Heat, promotes urination), Dan Shen (invigorates Blood, clears Heat, cools Blood) and Che Qian Zi (promotes urination, clears Damp-Heat).

中文必記

舌：舌淡紅苔潤。脈：脈滑濡。

治療原則：燥濕、利濁。

針灸：陰陵泉（SP9）、豐隆（ST40）、中極（CV3）、帶脈（GB26）、天樞（ST25）、水道（ST28）、支溝（SJ6）。

English必記

Ischuria — the urinary bladder does not rid itself of all urine it contains during the process of urination, or a lack of ability to urinate.

Causes:

  • A common complication of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).
  • Due to anesthesia and other medications.
  • Effects of renal dysfunction.
  • Obstruction in ureters or urethra.

Source note (not elaborated on the slide itself): "Retention of Urine — Maciocia, The Practice of Chinese Medicine, p. 533" — likely the origin of the Table 21.1 scanned reference table above.

尿瀦留——排尿過程中膀胱無法排空其中全部尿液，或完全無法排尿。

病因：

  • 良性前列腺增生（BPH）之常見併發症。
  • 因麻醉或其他藥物所致。
  • 腎功能不全之影響。
  • 輸尿管或尿道阻塞。

10.5良性前列腺增生（BPH）Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)

生物醫學概述Biomedical Overview
English必記
  • BPH is a non-malignant increase in growth of the prostate.
  • It interferes with the passage of urine through the urethra ⇒ urinary frequency, urgency, hesitancy, incontinence and nocturia.
  • Diagnosed by symptoms, digital rectal exam (DRE), and serum Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA).
  • 90% of men in their 80s have BPH at autopsy.
  • The prostate grows with stimulation from testosterone and estrogen.
  • If PSA is normal, likely BPH; if PSA is high, could be prostate cancer.
中文必記
  • BPH為前列腺非惡性增生。
  • 會阻礙尿液通過尿道，導致頻尿、急尿、排尿困難、失禁與夜尿。
  • 透過症狀、直腸指診（DRE）與PSA（前列腺特異性抗原）檢測診斷。
  • 80歲男性中90%於解剖時發現有前列腺增生。
  • 前列腺在睪固酮與雌激素刺激下增大。
  • 若PSA正常，多為BPH；若PSA偏高，則可能為前列腺癌。
BPH——中醫病因病機BPH — TCM Cause & Pathomechanism
English必記
  • Fundamental disease cause: Kidney Vacuity.
  • Main pathomechanism: Blood stasis caused by Kidney Qi deficiency.
  • If Kidney Yin is weak — not enough moisture, or deficient heat in the Blood ⇒ stasis.
  • If Kidney Yang is weak — not enough heat ⇒ Blood congeals or pools.
  • If both Kidney Yin and Yang are weak — not enough "vapour" from the cooking pot ⇒ leads to Blood deficiency.
中文必記
  • 根本病因：腎虛。
  • 主要病機：腎氣虛導致血瘀。
  • 若腎陰虛——濡潤不足，或血中有虛熱⇒致瘀。
  • 若腎陽虛——溫煦不足⇒血凝或血滯。
  • 若腎陰陽兩虛——如鍋中「蒸氣」不足⇒導致血虛。
BPH——中醫辨證分型（勘誤：原文即有，非僅Quiz重建）BPH — TCM Pattern Differentiation (Correction: Present in Source, Not Only Quiz-Reconstructed)

BPH——腎陽虛證BPH — Kidney Yang Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: inhibited urination (either difficult urination or uncontrolled urination); frequent urination (nocturia); clear, forceless urination; pale complexion; exhaustion; fear of cold; cold, retracted scrotum and penis.

Tongue: pale, wide. Pulse: slow, weak.

Treatment Principles: Warm Kidney Yang, Transform Qi and Move Water.

Acupuncture with moxa: CV 3, BL 28, CV 6, ST 28, KD 3, GV 20, ST 36, KD 7.

Formula: Ji Sheng Shen Qi Wan Modified (Modified Kidney Qi Pill) — Rou Gui, Fu Zi, Shu Di Huang, Shan Zhu Yu, Shan Yao, Fu Ling, Ze Xie, Mu Dan Pi, Chuan Niu Xi & Che Qian Zi (promote urination), Huang Qi (tonifies Qi), Yi Zhi Ren (warms Kidney/Spleen, astringes urine), Chen Xiang (warms Kidneys, moves Qi), Wang Bu Liu Xing, Tao Ren & Hong Hua (invigorate Blood).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：排尿受阻（排尿困難或失禁不受控）；小便頻數（夜尿）；小便清長無力；面色蒼白；疲乏；畏寒；陰囊與陰莖冷縮。

舌：舌淡而胖。脈：脈遲弱。

治療原則：溫補腎陽、化氣行水。

針灸（配合灸法）：中極（CV3）、膀胱俞（BL28）、氣海（CV6）、水道（ST28）、太谿（KD3）、百會（GV20）、足三里（ST36）、復溜（KD7）。

方劑：濟生腎氣丸加減——肉桂、附子、熟地黃、山茱萸、山藥、茯苓、澤瀉、牡丹皮，川牛膝與車前子（利尿），黃芪（補氣），益智仁（溫腎脾、縮尿），沉香（溫腎行氣），王不留行、桃仁與紅花（活血）。

BPH——腎陰虛證BPH — Kidney Yin Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: frequent, incomplete urination; scanty, yellowish-red urine; burning sensation with urination; frequent nocturia; dry mouth and throat; insomnia; malar flush; sore and weak low back and knees; tinnitus.

Tongue: red, dry, scanty coat. Pulse: fine, rapid.

Treatment Principles: Tonify Kidney Yin, Transform Qi and Move Water.

Acupuncture: CV 3, CV 4, KD 3, SP 10, ST 29, KD 10, BL 23, BL 22.

Formula: Zi Shen Tong Guan Wan combined with Zhi Bai Di Huang Wan Modified (Nourish the Kidneys & Open the Gate Pill + Modified Anemarrhena, Phellodendron & Rehmannia Pill) — Zhi Mu, Huang Bai (drains Damp-Heat from the lower jiao, clears Heat/fire), Sheng Di Huang, Shan Yao, Fu Ling, Mu Dan Pi, Ze Xie, and a small amount (3g) of Rou Gui (leads fire back to its source).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：尿頻、排尿不盡；尿量少、色黃紅；排尿灼熱感；夜尿頻繁；口乾咽燥；失眠；顴紅；腰膝痠軟；耳鳴。

舌：舌紅、乾、少苔。脈：脈細數。

治療原則：滋補腎陰、化氣行水。

針灸：中極（CV3）、關元（CV4）、太谿（KD3）、血海（SP10）、歸來（ST29）、陰谷（KD10）、腎俞（BL23）、三焦俞（BL22）。

方劑：滋腎通關丸合知柏地黃丸加減——知母、黃柏（清瀉下焦濕熱／虛火），生地黃、山藥、茯苓、牡丹皮、澤瀉，另加少量（3克）肉桂（引火歸源）。

BPH——氣滯血瘀證BPH — Qi Stagnation & Blood Stasis
English必記

Signs and symptoms: difficult urination — slight drips or thin stream; unsmooth urination; urinary urgency; fullness, distention and pain of the perineum and lower abdomen.

Tongue: dark purple, purple spots. Pulse: deep, wiry.

Treatment Principles: Move Qi and Blood, Disinhibit Urination.

Acupuncture: CV 3, BL 28, CV 6, SP 9, BL 22, GB 25, SP 10.

Formula: Dai Di Dang Wan Modified (Substituted Resistance Pill) — Da Huang & Dang Gui Wei (used together for Blood stasis), Sheng Di Huang, Tao Ren, Mang Xiao (softens hardness), Rou Gui, Niu Xi (invigorates Blood, clears Damp-Heat in the lower jiao), Hu Po (promotes/unblocks urination, reduces swelling), Zhe Bei Mu (clears Heat, dissipates nodules).

Alternate (if Liver-channel Qi stagnation/Blood stasis mechanism predominates): Chen Xiang San (Aquilaria Powder) — Chen Xiang, Shi Wei, Dong Kui Zi, Hua Shi, Wang Bu Liu Xing, Dang Gui, Bai Shao, Zhi Gan Cao, Chen Pi — dredges the Liver channel, promotes Qi circulation (per Bob Damone, p. 187).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：排尿困難——點滴而下或細如線；排尿不暢；尿急；會陰與下腹脹滿疼痛。

舌：舌暗紫、有瘀點。脈：脈沉弦。

治療原則：行氣活血、通利小便。

針灸：中極（CV3）、膀胱俞（BL28）、氣海（CV6）、陰陵泉（SP9）、三焦俞（BL22）、京門（GB25）、血海（SP10）。

方劑：代抵當丸加減——大黃與當歸尾（合用以化瘀），生地黃、桃仁、芒硝（軟堅散結），肉桂、牛膝（活血並清下焦濕熱），琥珀（利尿消腫），浙貝母（清熱散結）。

備選方（若肝經氣滯血瘀病機較顯著時）：沉香散——沉香、石韋、冬葵子、滑石、王不留行、當歸、白芍、炙甘草、陳皮——疏肝理氣（出處：Bob Damone著作第187頁）。

案例：JohnWorked Example: John
English

John comes to the clinic seeking help with his BPH symptoms. He complains of insomnia due to frequent nighttime urination; he feels the urge to go all the time, and when he does urinate, only a small amount comes out. He also struggles with dry mouth and tinnitus.

Tongue: red, with scanty coat. Pulse: rapid.

Pattern: Kidney Yin Deficiency — the empty-heat picture (dry mouth, tinnitus, red tongue with scanty coat, rapid pulse) on top of frequent, scanty, incomplete nighttime urination distinguishes this from the Kidney Yang deficiency and Qi Stagnation/Blood Stasis patterns above.

Formula: Zi Shen Tong Guan Wan combined with Zhi Bai Di Huang Wan Modified — i.e. the BPH — Kidney Yin Deficiency formula given above. (Correction: an earlier version of this note mis-cited Quiz 5 Q4 as the source for this formula — Q4 actually concerns the separate Turbid Dampness chronic-prostatitis case in §10.4, not John. The correct source for John's formula is the source slide deck's own BPH — Kidney Yin Deficiency formula slide, matched to John's pattern.)

中文

John 前來求診，主訴BPH相關症狀。因夜間頻尿而失眠；他常感有尿意，但每次排尿量少。同時伴有口乾與耳鳴。

舌：舌紅少苔。脈：脈數。

證型：腎陰虛——虛熱徵象（口乾、耳鳴、舌紅少苔、脈數）疊加於頻尿、量少、夜尿不盡之上，與上述腎陽虛、氣滯血瘀兩型可資鑑別。

方劑：滋腎通關丸合知柏地黃丸加減——即上方「BPH腎陰虛證」所列方劑，依John之證型對應套用。（勘誤：本節先前版本誤將此方劑來源標註為「Quiz 5第4題選項」——第4題實際對應之案例為§10.4另一濁濕下注型慢性前列腺炎案例，並非John。John方劑之正確依據為來源投影片本身之BPH腎陰虛證方劑段落，依其證型相符而套用。）

10.6勃起功能障礙與遺精Erectile Dysfunction & Seminal Emission

生物醫學概述Biomedical Overview
English必記

Erectile dysfunction is the inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual performance.

  • Organic causes — atherosclerosis, diabetes, side effect of medication, trauma, decreased androgen levels.
  • Psychological causes — disinterest in sexual partner, relationship discord, anxiety, fear of sexual incompetence, depression.

One key diagnostic feature between organic and psychological causes is whether the person experiences erections during sleep or in the early morning. If yes, likely psychological; if no, likely organic.

Impairment of blood flow (recap/extension of §10.1's corpus spongiosum/corpus cavernosum anatomy): Blood must also stay in the penis — smooth muscle insufficiency or abnormalities of the corpus cavernosum can prevent this. Diabetes, atherosclerosis or hypercholesterolemia can interfere with blood flow to and from the penis.

中文必記

勃起功能障礙係指無法達到或維持足夠之勃起，以完成滿意的性行為。

  • 器質性原因——動脈粥樣硬化、糖尿病、藥物副作用、外傷、雄激素下降。
  • 心理性原因——性興趣缺乏、關係衝突、焦慮、性能力焦慮、憂鬱。

區分器質性與心理性的重要診斷特徵之一，為是否於睡眠中或清晨有勃起。有則多為心理性，無則多為器質性。

血流受損（延伸自§10.1尿道海綿體／陰莖海綿體之解剖）：血液亦須留住於陰莖內——陰莖海綿體之平滑肌功能不足或結構異常，皆可能導致血液無法留住。糖尿病、動脈粥樣硬化或高膽固醇血症皆可能干擾陰莖之血流進出。

勃起功能障礙——肝氣鬱結證Erectile Dysfunction — Liver Qi Stagnation
English必記

Signs and symptoms: functional erectile dysfunction; depression; irritability; hypochondriac pain and distention; frequent sighing.

Tongue: purple, thin coat. Pulse: wiry.

Client usually represses his feelings or is under a lot of emotional pressure — consider infertility as a possible context.

Treatment Principle: Move Liver Qi, Resolve Liver Depression.

Acupuncture: LR 3, LI 4, CV 4, CV 3, BL 32, BL 18, SP 6, GV 1.

Formula: Chai Hu Shu Gan San Modified (Modified Bupleurum Powder to Spread the Liver) — Chai Hu, Sheng Ma (lifts sunken Qi), Xiang Fu, Chen Pi & Bai Ji Li (move Liver Qi), Bai Shao, Dang Gui, Chuan Xiong, Wu Gong & Lu Feng Fang (clear congestion obstructing free flow), Gan Cao.

中文必記

症狀與體徵：功能性勃起功能障礙；情緒低落；易怒；脅肋脹痛；頻頻嘆息。

舌：舌紫、苔薄。脈：脈弦。

患者通常壓抑情緒或承受較大情緒壓力——可能與不孕議題相關，宜一併考量。

治療原則：疏肝理氣、解肝鬱。

針灸：太衝（LR3）、合谷（LI4）、關元（CV4）、中極（CV3）、次髎（BL32）、肝俞（BL18）、三陰交（SP6）、長強（GV1）。

方劑：柴胡疏肝散加減——柴胡、升麻（升提下陷之氣）、香附、陳皮與白蒺藜（疏肝理氣）、白芍、當歸、川芎、蜈蚣與露蜂房（通絡散結），甘草。

勃起功能障礙——肝經濕熱證Erectile Dysfunction — Liver Damp-Heat
〈勘誤：本節先前版本誤稱「兩份PDF文字擷取檔案完全未提及任何中醫證型」、以下內容「完整取自Quiz 5」而非任一文字擷取來源。經重新比對來源簡報文字擷取檔案（10 - Andrology.pptx，投影片45–47）確認：此證型（含症狀體徵、舌脈、治療原則、針灸、方劑與完整藥物組成）確實存在於原始投影片文字內容中，PDF文字擷取檔案（Gynaecology_10/11）之缺漏原因與§10.5 BPH證型相同——PDF匯出本身在「Erectile Dysfunction」生物醫學概述之後即提前中斷，並非投影片以圖片呈現而遺失。以下已依投影片原文補充完整之針灸與方劑組成；Robert案例（Quiz 5第7、8題，各1/1滿分）之症狀描述與投影片原文逐字相符，可作為交叉驗證。〉
English必記

Signs and symptoms: slow onset, soft penis; distention of lower abdomen; soreness and distention of perineum and inguinal region; dribbling, unsmooth, incomplete urination; frequent urination of yellow, turbid urine; scrotal sweating, dampness, itching, malodor; bitter taste in mouth.

Tongue: red, thick yellow coat. Pulse: wiry, rapid, slippery.

Damp-Heat is in the Liver channel — this pattern presents in men with a history of excessive alcohol intake or genitourinary tract infections/inflammation.

Case — Robert: unable to perform sexually; takes a long time to be aroused, and when he finally obtains an erection it is described as soft. He also experiences lower abdominal distension, with incomplete, dribbling, unsmooth urination. His urine is described as yellow and sometimes cloudy. Tongue: red, yellow coating. Pulse: wiry, slippery, rapid.

Treatment Principle: Clear Heat, Drain Damp, Clear Liver Channel.

Acupuncture: LR 5, LR 8, SP 9, ST 40, BL 19, BL 28, CV 3.

Formula: Long Dan Xie Gan Tang Modified (Gentiana Longdancao Decoction to Drain the Liver) — Long Dan Cao, Zhi Zi, Huang Bai (drain excess Liver fire, drain Damp-Heat from the lower jiao), Bai Shao, Dang Gui, Mu Dan Pi, Bei Xie (resolves turbid dampness in the lower jiao), Ze Xie, Li Zhi He (regulates Liver Qi in the Liver channel), Bai Mao Gen (clears Heat, promotes urination, for Lin syndrome), Wu Gong (dissipates nodules, unblocks collaterals).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：起病緩慢、陰莖疲軟；下腹脹滿；會陰及腹股溝區痠脹；排尿滴瀝、不暢、不盡；小便頻數、色黃混濁；陰囊多汗、潮濕、瘙癢、有異味；口苦。

舌：舌紅、苔厚黃。脈：脈弦滑數。

濕熱在肝經——此證型多見於有酗酒史或泌尿生殖道感染／發炎病史之男性。

案例——Robert：無法完成性行為；需長時間才能被喚起性慾，即使最終獲得勃起，亦形容為疲軟。同時伴有下腹脹滿，排尿不盡、滴瀝、不暢。小便形容為色黃、時而混濁。舌紅苔黃，脈弦滑數。

治療原則：清熱、利濕、清瀉肝經。

針灸：蠡溝（LR5）、曲泉（LR8）、陰陵泉（SP9）、豐隆（ST40）、膽俞（BL19）、膀胱俞（BL28）、中極（CV3）。

方劑：龍膽瀉肝湯加減——龍膽草、梔子、黃柏（瀉肝經實火、清下焦濕熱），白芍、當歸、牡丹皮、萆薢（化下焦濁濕）、澤瀉、荔枝核（疏理肝經之氣）、白茅根（清熱利尿，治淋證）、蜈蚣（散結通絡）。

勃起功能障礙——心脾兩虛證Erectile Dysfunction — Heart & Spleen Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: low libido ⇒ limp or soft erection ⇒ no erection; fatigue; insomnia; vivid dreams; poor memory; palpitations; spontaneous sweating; low appetite; loose stools.

Tongue: pale, swollen with teeth marks, thin coat. Pulse: weak, fine.

Pattern in men with consumption of Qi and Blood from enduring illness and general weakness, from excessive use of their mental capacity in their work (professors, writers, researchers, scientists, etc.), and from excessive worry and preoccupation.

Treatment Principles: Tonify Spleen Qi, Nourish Heart, Calm Spirit.

Acupuncture: BL 20, CV 6, CV 12, CV 17, HT 7, PC 6, CV 4, ST 36.

Formula: Gui Pi Tang (Restore the Spleen Decoction) — Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Fu Ling, Gan Cao, Huang Qi, Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou, Suan Zao Ren, Yuan Zhi, Mu Xiang.

中文必記

症狀與體徵：性慾低下⇒勃起無力或疲軟⇒完全不能勃起；疲乏；失眠；多夢；健忘；心悸；自汗；食慾不振；大便溏薄。

舌：舌淡胖有齒痕、苔薄。脈：脈弱細。

多見於久病體虛耗傷氣血者、長期用腦過度者（如教授、作家、研究人員、科學家等），以及過度憂思者。

治療原則：健脾益氣、養心安神。

針灸：脾俞（BL20）、氣海（CV6）、中脘（CV12）、膻中（CV17）、神門（HT7）、內關（PC6）、關元（CV4）、足三里（ST36）。

方劑：歸脾湯——人參、白朮、茯苓、甘草、黃芪、當歸、龍眼肉、酸棗仁、遠志、木香。

勃起功能障礙——命門火衰證Erectile Dysfunction — Ming Men Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: complete or partial lack of erection; pale facial complexion; dizziness; tinnitus; sore and weak low back and knees; cold lower abdomen; cold limbs; aversion to cold; profuse nocturia; frequent urination; inhibited urination.

Tongue: pale, teeth marks. Pulse: fine, weak.

This pattern generally occurs in men with constitutional deficiency, in older men, or in men with chronic illness.

Treatment Principles: Warm Ming Men, Invigorate Yang.

Acupuncture with moxibustion: BL 23, CV 4, GV 4, ST 36, GV 20.

Formula: Zan Yu Dan (Special Pill to Aid Fertility) — Fu Zi, Rou Gui, Yin Yang Huo, Ba Ji Tian, She Chuang Zi, Rou Cong Rong, Xian Mao, Du Zhong, Jiu Cai Zi (supplements the Liver, warms the Kidneys, fortifies Yang, astringes Jing), Shu Di Huang, Shan Zhu Yu (astringing function), Dang Gui, Gou Qi Zi, Bai Zhu (uplifts Spleen Qi, dries Dampness, promotes water metabolism).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：完全或部分無法勃起；面色蒼白；頭暈；耳鳴；腰膝痠軟；下腹冷；四肢冰冷；畏寒；夜尿頻多；小便頻數；排尿不暢。

舌：舌淡、有齒痕。脈：脈細弱。

此證型多見於先天不足之體質、年長男性，或久病體弱者。

治療原則：溫補命門、振奮陽氣。

針灸（配合灸法）：腎俞（BL23）、關元（CV4）、命門（GV4）、足三里（ST36）、百會（GV20）。

方劑：贊育丹——附子、肉桂、淫羊藿、巴戟天、蛇床子、肉蓯蓉、仙茅、杜仲、韭菜子（補肝溫腎、壯陽固精），熟地黃、山茱萸（固澀），當歸、枸杞子、白朮（升脾氣、燥濕、助運化水濕）。

勃起功能障礙——腎陰虛證Erectile Dysfunction — Kidney Yin Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: hyperactive libido; erection not firm enough, rapidly wilts; insomnia; excessive dreaming; nocturnal seminal emission; five-palm heat; sore and weak low back and knees; dizziness; tinnitus; scanty, reddish urine.

Tongue: red, thin yellow coat. Pulse: fine, rapid.

Pattern in men with constitutional insufficiency of Yin essence, or who have had excessive sexual activity.

Treatment Principles: Nourish Yin, Clear Heat, Replenish Essence.

Acupuncture: CV 3, CV 4, BL 23, KD 2, KD 6, SP 6.

Formula: Zhi Bai Di Huang Wan Modified (Modified Anemarrhena, Phellodendron & Rehmannia Pill) — Zhi Mu, Huang Bai, Sheng Di Huang, Shan Yao, Shan Zhu Yu, Mu Dan Pi, Fu Ling, Ze Xie, Gui Ban & Bie Jia (tortoise-shell products — tonify Yin, subdue Yang, soften hardness; Bie Jia enters the Liver channel with a stronger ability to enrich Yin, Gui Ban enters the Kidney, enriches Yin and anchors Yang, unblocks the Ren channel and the Heart).

中文必記

症狀與體徵：性慾亢進；勃起不堅、易痿；失眠；多夢；夜間遺精；五心煩熱；腰膝痠軟；頭暈；耳鳴；小便量少色紅。

舌：舌紅、苔薄黃。脈：脈細數。

多見於先天陰精不足之體質，或性生活過度者。

治療原則：滋陰、清熱、填精。

針灸：中極（CV3）、關元（CV4）、腎俞（BL23）、然谷（KD2）、照海（KD6）、三陰交（SP6）。

方劑：知柏地黃丸加減——知母、黃柏、生地黃、山藥、山茱萸、牡丹皮、茯苓、澤瀉，龜板與鱉甲（龜鱉類藥材——滋陰潛陽、軟堅散結；鱉甲主入肝經、滋陰力較強，龜板主入腎經、滋陰潛陽、通任脈、通心）。

遺精——概述與分型（新增小節）Seminal Emission — Overview & Patterns (New Subsection)
〈新增內容揭露：「遺精」為原文（本節開頭§10.4總覽段落）五大重點泌尿生殖疾病之一，PDF文字擷取檔案完全未提及此病之任何內容（僅在總覽處列出病名），本模組先前版本亦未單獨列出其小節。經重新比對來源簡報文字擷取檔案（10 - Andrology.pptx，投影片57–70）確認：原文對遺精有完整之定義與四種辨證分型（含症狀體徵、舌脈、治療原則、針灸〔如原文有列〕、方劑與完整藥物組成），皆為投影片本身之文字內容，並非圖片，此為PDF匯出缺漏所致（與§10.5 BPH、本節肝經濕熱證之缺漏屬同一系統性成因），現已據以補足於下方。〉
English必記

Seminal emission is the passing of seminal fluid during sleep or during the day without sexual excitement. Frequency of more than twice a week is the diagnostic threshold.

Four patterns are named:

  • Heart and Kidney not communicating
  • Damp-Heat rushing downward
  • Heart and Spleen Qi deficiency
  • Kidney Deficiency

General pathomechanism notes on Kidney Deficiency: deficient Kidneys failing to store Essence; excess fire of Heart and Kidneys; Damp-Heat or phlegm-fire rushing downward.

中文必記

遺精係指睡眠中或白天在無性興奮之情況下，精液自行洩出。每週發生超過兩次即達診斷門檻。

原文列出四種辨證分型：

  • 心腎不交
  • 濕熱下注
  • 心脾氣虛
  • 腎虛

腎虛之整體病機備註：腎虛不能藏精；心腎火旺；濕熱或痰火下注。

遺精——心腎不交證Seminal Emission — Heart & Kidney Not Communicating
English必記

Signs and symptoms: insomnia, vivid dreams; seminal emission when sleeping; dizziness; anxiety; restlessness; poor memory; dry mouth; frequent urination, yellow urine.

Tongue: red. Pulse: thready, rapid.

Treatment Principle: Nourish Kidney Yin, Clear Heat, Calm Spirit.

Acupuncture: HT 7, KD 3, BL 23, BL 52, BL 15, Yin Tang, Ear Shenmen, CV 6, CV 17.

Formula: San Cai Feng Sui Dan (Three Talents Powder to Seal the Marrow) — Tian Men Dong, Shu Di Huang, Ren Shen, Huang Bai, Sha Ren, Gan Cao; modify with Huang Lian, Dang Gui, Suan Zao Ren, Yuan Zhi, Lian Zi.

中文必記

症狀與體徵：失眠、多夢；睡眠中遺精；頭暈；焦慮；心神不寧；健忘；口乾；小便頻數、色黃。

舌：舌紅。脈：脈細數。

治療原則：滋腎陰、清熱、安神。

針灸：神門（HT7）、太谿（KD3）、腎俞（BL23）、志室（BL52）、心俞（BL15）、印堂、耳神門、氣海（CV6）、膻中（CV17）。

方劑：三才封髓丹——天門冬、熟地黃、人參、黃柏、砂仁、甘草；隨證加減：黃連、當歸、酸棗仁、遠志、蓮子。

遺精——濕熱下注證Seminal Emission — Damp-Heat Rushing Downward
English必記

Signs and symptoms: frequent seminal emission; cloudy urine; burning with urination; bitter taste in the mouth; thirst; irritability; insomnia; sores on the tongue and mouth; unformed, foul-smelling stool; abdominal distention; nausea.

Tongue: thick yellow coat. Pulse: slippery, rapid.

Treatment Principles: Clear Heat, Drain Damp.

Acupuncture: LI 11, LR 2, SP 9, BL 22, CV 3, ST 29.

Formula: Bei Xie Feng Qing Yin (Dioscorea Hypoglauca Decoction to Separate the Clear) — Bei Xie (resolves turbid dampness in the lower jiao), Yi Zhi Ren (warms Kidneys, astringes), Wu Yao (moves Qi, warms Kidneys), Shi Chang Pu (transforms turbid dampness); modify with Huang Bai, Che Qian Zi. Alternate herbal formula per source notes: Bei Xie, Huang Bai, Fu Ling, Che Qian Zi (first four clear Heat and Dampness), Lian Zi Xin, Dan Shen, Shi Chang Pu (next three clear the Heart and calm the Spirit), Bai Zhu (strengthens the Spleen, excretes Dampness).

症狀與體徵：頻繁遺精；小便混濁；排尿灼熱；口苦；口渴；煩躁；失眠；舌與口腔生瘡；大便不成形、臭穢；腹脹；噁心。

舌：苔厚黃。脈：脈滑數。

針灸：曲池（LI11）、行間（LR2）、陰陵泉（SP9）、三焦俞（BL22）、中極（CV3）、歸來（ST29）。

方劑：萆薢分清飲——萆薢（化下焦濁濕）、益智仁（溫腎固澀）、烏藥（行氣溫腎）、石菖蒲（化濁）；隨證加黃柏、車前子。原文另列一組備選藥味：萆薢、黃柏、茯苓、車前子（前四味清熱利濕）、蓮子心、丹參、石菖蒲（清心安神）、白朮（健脾利濕）。

遺精——心脾氣虛證Seminal Emission — Heart & Spleen Qi Deficiency
English必記

Signs and symptoms: seminal emission on overwork; palpitations; restlessness; insomnia; poor memory; pale facial complexion; fatigue, heavy limbs; poor appetite; unformed stool.

Tongue: pale, thin coat. Pulse: thready, weak.

Treatment Principle: Tonify Heart and Spleen Qi, Astringe Essence.

Formula: Gui Pi Tang (Restore the Spleen Decoction) — Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Fu Ling, Gan Cao, Huang Qi, Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou, Suan Zao Ren, Yuan Zhi, Mu Xiang.

中文必記

症狀與體徵：勞累後遺精；心悸；心神不寧；失眠；健忘；面色蒼白；疲乏、肢體沉重；食慾不振；大便不成形。

舌：舌淡、苔薄。脈：脈細弱。

針灸：足三里（ST36）、脾俞（BL20）、心俞（BL15）、關元（CV4）、氣海（CV6）、中脘（CV12）、百會（GV20）。

方劑：歸脾湯——人參、白朮、茯苓、甘草、黃芪、當歸、龍眼肉、酸棗仁、遠志、木香。

遺精——腎虛證Seminal Emission — Kidney Deficiency
English必記

The source presents this pattern with two symptom sub-groups, to be differentiated as Yin- or Yang-type Kidney deficiency (the formula below is explicitly modified for either):

Yin-type signs/symptoms: frequent nocturnal emissions; aching pains of loins and knees; dry throat; irritability; dizziness; tinnitus; poor memory; insomnia; malar flush; night sweats; hair loss. Tongue: red, no coat. Pulse: thready, rapid.

Yang-type signs/symptoms: cold limbs; impotence; premature ejaculation; profuse nocturia; edema; pale face. Tongue: pale, swollen with teeth marks. Pulse: deep, thready.

Treatment Principle: Tonify Kidney Essence, Astringe Essence. (No acupuncture points are given in the source for this pattern.)

Formula: Jin Suo Gu Jing Wan (Metal Lock Pill to Stabilize the Essence) — Sha Yuan Zi (tonifies Kidney Yang, stops leakage of semen), Qian Shi (stabilizes Kidneys, astringes Essence), Lian Xu (stabilizes Kidneys, nourishes Essence — paired with Lian Zi for seminal emission), Lian Zi (tonifies Kidneys, astringes semen), Duan Long Gu & Duan Mu Li (calcined — astringe Essence), Jin Ying Zi (astringes Essence), Suo Yang (tonifies Kidney Yang, fortifies Essence, nourishes Blood), Bai Ji Li (calms the Liver, anchors Yang). Modify for Kidney Yin or Yang as indicated by the presenting sub-group.

中文必記

原文將本證型分為兩組症狀，依偏陰虛或偏陽虛分型論治（下方方劑原文明確指出可隨陰陽偏勝加減）：

偏陰虛症狀：夜間頻繁遺精；腰膝痠痛；咽乾；煩躁；頭暈；耳鳴；健忘；失眠；顴紅；盜汗；脫髮。舌：舌紅無苔。脈：脈細數。

偏陽虛症狀：四肢冰冷；陽痿；早洩；夜尿頻多；水腫；面色蒼白。舌：舌淡胖有齒痕。脈：脈沉細。

治療原則：補腎填精、固澀精關。（原文此處未列本證型之針灸穴位。）

方劑：金鎖固精丸——沙苑子（溫補腎陽、止遺精）、芡實（固腎澀精）、蓮鬚（固腎養精，與蓮子相配治遺精）、蓮子（補腎澀精）、煅龍骨與煅牡蠣（固澀精關）、金櫻子（澀精）、鎖陽（補腎陽、固精、養血）、白蒺藜（平肝潛陽）。依偏陰虛或偏陽虛隨證加減。

10.7病例研究：JosephCase Study: Joseph

English必記

Joseph, 58-year-old male. Chief concern: urinary difficulty.

  • 6 months ago he experienced a sudden onset of lower abdominal discomfort which then progressed to urinary difficulty.
  • He described that it took 10 minutes of effort when attempting to urinate before any urine would flow.
  • In the past 3 weeks, urination had required great effort; the quantity of urine was scanty and came out only in dribbles.
  • There was also a sensation of distention and oppression in the lower abdomen.
  • The patient was also relatively overweight; his spirit was devitalized and he had an anguished facial expression.
  • Digital rectal exam revealed a walnut-sized prostate.
  • Pulse: deep, moderate. Tongue: red, no coat.

Source: Bob Damone — Principles of Chinese Medical Andrology, p. 200.

  • Excess or Deficiency? Both.
  • Which Jiao is affected? Lower Jiao.
  • Which organs are involved? Kidneys.
  • Diagnosis: Retention of Urine (BPH).
  • Differentiation: Kidney Qi deficiency; Damp accumulation.
  • Treatment Principle: Tonify Kidney Qi; Drain Dampness.

Herbal Formula (initial prescription, 3 packets): Huang Qi 30g, Ze Xie 12g, Yi Yi Ren 12g, Chi Shao 12g, Mu Dan Pi 10g, Bai Zhu 10g, Tao Ren 10g, Hong Hua 10g, Fu Ling 10g, Xiang Fu 10g, Bian Xu 6g, Gan Cao 6g, Rou Gui 3g. (Note: a notably large dose of Huang Qi.)

Follow-up (after 3 packets): quantity of urine increased; difficulty urinating decreased; slight dribbling changed to a sluggish trickle; decreased lower abdominal discomfort; pulse increased in force (dampness starting to move).

Herbal Formula (revised prescription, 5 packets): Huang Qi 60g, Shan Yao 15g, Ze Xie 12g, Da Fu Pi 12g, Sheng Di Huang 12g, Bai Zhu 10g, Fu Ling 10g, Chi Shao 10g, Tao Ren 10g, San Leng 10g, Qian Niu Zi 6g, Rou Gui 3g. (Huang Qi dose doubled to 60g; Shan Yao added for its astringing function; San Leng added to break up Blood stasis; Qian Niu Zi added to drive out water via urine and stool.)

Follow-up (after 5 packets): urination was smooth; lesser abdominal discomfort relieved; spirit was clear and strengthened. He continued to take the formula for maintenance and to prevent relapse.

中文必記

Joseph，58歲男性。主訴：排尿困難。

  • 六個月前突然出現下腹不適，並逐漸發展為排尿困難。
  • 他描述每次排尿需用力10分鐘，才開始有尿液排出。
  • 過去三週排尿需非常用力，且尿量少，只能滴出。
  • 並伴有下腹脹滿與壓迫感。

  • 直腸指診顯示前列腺如核桃大小。
  • 脈：脈沉中。舌：舌紅無苔。

來源：Bob Damone《中醫男科學原理》第200頁。

  • 虛或實？兩者皆有。

方劑（首診處方，3帖）：黃芪30克、澤瀉12克、薏苡仁12克、赤芍12克、牡丹皮10克、白朮10克、桃仁10克、紅花10克、茯苓10克、香附10克、萹蓄6克、甘草6克、肉桂3克。（備註：黃芪劑量明顯偏大。）

隨訪（服3帖後）：尿量增加；排尿困難減少；輕微滴尿改善為緩慢細流；下腹不適減少；脈力增強（濕開始化）。

隨訪（服5帖後）：排尿順暢；下腹不適感消失；精神轉為清明並增強。持續服用該方劑以維持療效並預防復發。

Module 10 Exam Focus 考點整理 · based on CTCMPAO question patterns

依你提供的1000題題庫（q1000，共946題）以關鍵字比對：prostatitis／BPH／benign prostatic／erectile／impotence／andrology／testis／epididymis／scrotum／vas deferens／ejaculation／seminal emission／spermatorrhea／ischuria／urinary retention／corpus cavernosum／corpus spongiosum／前列腺／陽痿／勃起／男科／睪丸／附睪／陰囊／輸精管／遺精／精囊／尿瀦留 等，共比對出12題直接相關題目（Q107、Q115、Q135、Q149、Q252、Q387、Q460、Q617、Q667、Q821、Q853、Q869）。與 Module 8／9 的「幾乎零命中」情形不同，本模組主題（男科／泌尿生殖）在題庫中有實質命中，反映男科證型辨證（尤其陽痿與遺精）是題庫測驗的常見主題，即使本模組自身之PDF文字對這兩項的中醫辨證著墨甚少（勃起功能障礙僅有生物醫學分類，遺精甚至未被課程PDF提及）。以下考點依實際命中題目整理，並標明題號供查核，並非題庫原文照抄。
  • 陽痿（勃起功能障礙）辨證與選穴——題庫的重點遠超本模組PDF本身 Impotence pattern differentiation & point selection — the bank goes well beyond this module's own PDF：題庫以「陽痿」為關鍵字直接命中5題（Q107、Q115、Q135、Q667、Q821），皆考核不同證型（心脾腎陽虛型 vs. 肝經濕熱型）之舌脈鑑別及對應選穴，遠比本模組PDF本身（僅區分器質性／心理性）更深入中醫辨證細節。Q115之「口苦、口渴、小便灼熱色深、苔黃膩、脈細數」證型（肝俞、腎俞、太衝、行間）與本模組§10.6新增之「肝經濕熱」ED證型（Robert案例）屬同一證型家族，可交叉記憶。
  • Q667「陽痿最佳處方」與Q821「灸法用穴」 Q667 "best prescription for impotence" & Q821 "moxa point for impotence"：Q667正解為關元（Ren4）、腎俞（BL23）、三陰交（SP6）——腎虛型陽痿之基礎組方；Q821正解為關元（Ren4）單穴灸法，兩題皆以關元為核心穴位，與§10.4氣滯血瘀證之「中極（CV3）」同屬任脈下腹要穴，但取穴之經絡邏輯不同（關元偏重補腎陽，中極偏重利膀胱），常為混淆焦點。
  • Q135：問診四要點 Q135 — the four screening questions：陽痿／早洩患者問診時，須詢問耳鳴、落髮、腰痛、盜汗（正解「以上皆是」）——此四項為腎精虧虛之典型篩檢症狀，與本模組§10.3腎精八年週期之衰退進程（40歲後頭髮脫落、56歲後筋脈拘急、64歲牙齒脫落）邏輯相通。
  • Q460：前列腺肥大（BPH）之瀉法選穴 Q460 — BPH treated by reducing method：39歲男性前列腺肥大，小腹脹滿疼痛，舌質青紫苔薄白，脈沉弦（氣滯血瘀型）——正解為瀉法針刺水道（ST28）、中極（CV3）、太衝（LV3）。此組穴位與本模組§10.4氣滯血瘀型前列腺炎之穴位（太衝、合谷、中極、會陰、秩邊、血海、膈俞）及§10.4新增之濁濕下注證穴位（SP9、ST40、CV3、GB26）三者互相比較，僅中極（CV3）三者皆有，是下焦泌尿／前列腺病症之共通錨定穴，其餘配穴則隨證型不同而改變，此為常見考點陷阱。
  • Q149：陰囊腫脹疑似疝氣——濕熱下注 Q149 — scrotal swelling, suspected hernia — damp-heat pouring down：舌紅苔黃膩、脈數滑，正解為「濕熱下注」——與本模組濁濕下注型前列腺炎、肝經濕熱型ED同屬「濕熱」病機大家族，僅病位（陰囊 vs. 前列腺 vs. 陰莖）不同，此為題庫測驗「同一病機、不同病位」出題邏輯之典型範例。
  • Q252 vs. Q387：遺精的兩種截然不同證型 Q252 vs. Q387 — two very different patterns behind seminal emission：遺精（本模組PDF列為五大重點疾病之一，但課程PDF本身未展開辨證）在題庫中至少考核兩種證型——Q252「精神萎靡、疲乏、面色蒼白、舌淡苔白、脈沉弱」為單純腎氣不固；Q387「腰痠、遺精、潮熱、盜汗、失眠、心神不寧、健忘、頭暈耳鳴、舌紅少苔、脈沉細數」則為心腎不交（腎陰虛疊加心火）。此二題示範「同一症狀（遺精），虛實寒熱可完全不同」，考生易誤將所有遺精案例都判為單純腎虛。
  • Q617：術後尿瀦留——與Joseph案例的對照 Q617 — post-surgical urinary retention, contrasted with the Joseph case：術後經氣受損所致尿瀦留，小腹脹滿隱痛，舌有紫斑，脈澀（血瘀型）——正解為平補平瀉中極（CV3）、三陰交（SP6）、水道（ST28）、水泉（KI5）。此與本模組§10.7 Joseph案例（診斷同為「尿瀦留」，但辨證為腎氣虛＋濕聚，治則為補腎氣、利濕，並非血瘀）形成鮮明對照，說明「尿瀦留」是一個生物醫學病名傘，底下可對應多種截然不同的中醫證型與治法，不可見「尿瀦留」三字就直接套用單一方案。

選擇題正解之查證方法與信心分級：quiz5_text.txt 為 Blackboard「Assessment Feedback」批改畫面之文字擷取，其中配對題（Q1圖示配對、Q5 BPH證型配對）因作答格式本身即為「提示→答案」逐項並列，故可直接、逐字確認學生實際提交且已批改為正確之配對內容，信心程度為「逐字確認」。單選題（Q2、Q3、Q4、Q6、Q7、Q8）因Blackboard批改畫面在此匯出片段中僅顯示「題目、四個選項、總分（如1/1）」，並未顯示學生實際勾選之選項字母或系統標記之正解選項，故無法單獨依quiz5_text.txt逐字確認何者為官方正解；惟經與PPTX文字擷取檔案交叉比對後，六題之正解皆可由投影片原文（症狀描述、治療原則、方劑組成）唯一確定，不再依賴薄弱的選項鑑別度推論——例如Q2（千金仙湯活血藥組成）之正解「王不留行、穿山甲、桃仁」，即為投影片13號筆記中明確標示「Invigorates Blood」之藥物群組子集；Q3、Q4（濁濕下注穴位／方劑）之正解，逐字對應投影片15、16號之穴位與方劑名稱。故本模組單選題之正解信心程度現已提升為「高，且可追溯至原始投影片文字」。

Quiz 5 第1題（解剖圖配對，5/6）之處理：該題原始得分5/6，即六組配對中有一組錯誤，惟Blackboard批改畫面僅顯示總分與六組「提示→答案」，未標示究竟哪一組為誤答。本模組已取得本模組所用之原始解剖圖（image1.png，見§10.1圖片），逐一核對六組配對（A射精管、B膀胱、C輸精管、D陰囊、E副睪、F睪丸）：六者於解剖學上皆為圖中確實存在、位置互不相同之獨立構造，六組「名稱—定義」配對本身在概念上皆屬正確之陳述。據此研判，實際扣分之1分，較可能為配對操作介面上「拖曳至相鄰空格」之操作型失誤（例如將副睪與睪丸兩個相鄰空格對調），而非六個名詞定義本身有任何一項是概念性錯誤——但因原始批改紀錄未保留具體錯誤所在，此僅為合理推論，無法百分之百還原。本模組11.2節Quiz 5第1題之六個互動測驗項目，已依此以「高信心呈現全部六組配對＋誠實揭露此項不確定性」之方式處理，未迴避亦未假裝百分之百還原原始扣分點。

11男科學（中醫）Andrology (TCM) 男科

11.1與 Module 10 之關係說明Relationship to Module 10

English

This module's original course export ("11_Andrology男科.pdf," 119 lines of pdftotext -layout text) and Module 10's export ("10_Andrology Biomedical.pdf," 303 lines) come from the exact same source presentation. A md5sum check of the two original PowerPoint files (10 - Andrology.pptx and 11 - Andrology.pptx) confirms they are byte-for-byte identical (hash 9ff4aecd34d2a33de698f41eda33e993) — the course simply exported the same deck to PDF twice, once for a lesson labeled "10" and once for a lesson labeled "11."

Line-by-line comparison of the two text extractions confirms Module 11's content is a strict, truncated subset of Module 10's: it covers Urogenital Anatomy, the TCM organ-system theory (Heart/Spleen/Liver/Kidney), and the Kidney Essence 8-year cycle — then stops. It contains nothing beyond what Module 10 §10.1–§10.3 already cover in full, including the same figures.

Per this project's established convention for handling duplicate source decks (see Module 9 §9.3, which cross-references Module 8 §8.1 rather than re-pasting shared content), this section does not repeat that material a second time. Read the full bilingual anatomy, TCM-organ-theory and Kidney-Essence content at Module 10 §10.1 – §10.3. This is a deliberate non-duplication decision, not an omission — every sentence in Module 11's own source text is accounted for in Module 10.

What Module 11 does host that is genuinely its own is the interactive practice quiz below (§11.2) — the course's Quiz 5: Andrology, which in turn introduces some clinically real, examined content (BPH pattern differentiation, additional Erectile Dysfunction pattern/formula) that appears in neither PDF's extracted text. That new content has been written up as formal topic material in Module 10 §10.4–§10.6 (with full disclosure of its Quiz-5 sourcing there); here it is presented as interactive practice questions only.

中文

本模組原始課程匯出檔案（「11_Andrology男科.pdf」，pdftotext -layout 版本共119行）與 Module 10 之匯出檔案（「10_Andrology Biomedical.pdf」，共303行），來自完全相同的原始簡報。經 md5sum 核對兩份原始PowerPoint檔案（10 - Andrology.pptx 與 11 - Andrology.pptx），雜湊值完全相同（9ff4aecd34d2a33de698f41eda33e993）——課程實際上將同一份簡報匯出為PDF兩次，一次標記為第10課，一次標記為第11課。

逐行比對兩份文字擷取檔案後確認，Module 11 之內容為 Module 10 內容之嚴格、被截斷的子集：僅涵蓋泌尿生殖解剖、中醫臟腑理論（心脾肝腎）與腎精八年週期——即在此便完全終止。除此之外，本模組原始文字未包含任何 Module 10 §10.1–§10.3 尚未涵蓋之內容，連附圖亦相同。

依本專案處理「重複來源簡報」之既有慣例（參見 Module 9 §9.3 對 Module 8 §8.1 之交叉參考處理方式，而非逐句重新收錄），本節不再重複收錄該部分內容。完整雙語解剖、中醫臟腑理論與腎精八年週期內容，請見 Module 10 §10.1–§10.3。此為刻意之不重複收錄決定，而非遺漏——本模組原始文字之每一句陳述，皆已於 Module 10 中收錄。

本模組真正屬於自身、且未見於 Module 10 §10.1–§10.3 的部分，是下方11.2節之互動練習測驗——課程原始之「Quiz 5：男科學」，其內容另外引入部分未見於兩份PDF文字擷取檔案之真實課程內容（BPH辨證分型、勃起功能障礙之新增證型）。此新增內容已以正式主題內容形式撰寫於 Module 10 §10.4–§10.6（並於該處完整揭露其Quiz 5來源），此處僅以互動測驗題目形式呈現，不另重複撰寫為主題內文。

〈Confidence: high, not verbatim-confirmed〉The export only shows the total score (1/1), not which option was selected. 12男性生育力Male Fertility

12.1泌尿生殖解剖與精子路徑Urogenital Anatomy & the Sperm Pathway

English必記

The course frames this topic as a single describable pathway — the route sperm travel from production to ejaculation:

  • Sperm is produced in the Testis (睪丸).
  • It travels to and is stored in the Epididymis (副睪), sitting on/behind the testis.
  • From there it passes through the Vas Deferens (輸精管, Ductus Deferens) — the long muscular tube carrying sperm upward toward the pelvis.
  • Along the way, secretions are added from the Seminal Vesicle (精囊) and the Bulbourethral (Cowper's) Gland (庫柏腺／尿道球腺).
  • The mixture then passes through the short Ejaculatory Duct (射精管), which runs through the prostate gland.
  • Finally it exits the body via the Urethra (尿道).

Full pathway: Testis → Epididymis (storage) → Vas Deferens (+ Seminal Vesicle and Cowper's Gland secretions join along the route) → Ejaculatory Duct (through the prostate) → Urethra → out of the body.

中文必記

課程將此主題整理為一條可完整描述的路徑——精子從生成到射出體外所經之路線：

  • 精子於睪丸生成。
  • 精子隨後被運送並儲存於副睪，副睪位於睪丸上方／後方。
  • 自副睪起，精子經輸精管——一條將精子向上輸送至骨盆腔之長條肌性管道。
  • 途中會加入精囊與庫柏腺（尿道球腺）之分泌物。
  • 混合後之精液接著經過穿行於前列腺內之短管射精管。
  • 最終經尿道排出體外。

完整路徑：睪丸→副睪（儲存）→輸精管（途中加入精囊與庫柏腺分泌物）→射精管（穿過前列腺）→尿道→排出體外。

12.2下丘腦－垂體－睪丸軸與精子生成The HPT (Hypothalamus-Pituitary-Testes) Axis & Spermatogenesis

HPT軸與回饋循環The HPT Axis & Feedback Loop
English必記
  • The anterior pituitary releases FSH and LH.
  • FSH stimulates Sertoli cells → sperm production; maturation of a sperm takes about 75–90 days.
  • LH stimulates Leydig cells → testosterone production.
  • Spermatogenesis is a constant process, so FSH and LH exist in a constant feedback loop.
  • FSH stimulates the Sertoli cells that support the development of sperm.
  • LH stimulates the Leydig cells that produce testosterone — this feeds back to the pituitary to control testosterone levels.
中文必記
  • 腦下垂體前葉釋放FSH與LH。
  • FSH刺激支持細胞（Sertoli cells）→促進精子生成；精子成熟約需75–90天。
  • LH刺激Leydig細胞→產生睪固酮。
  • 精子生成為持續性過程，因此FSH與LH存在持續性回饋循環。
  • FSH刺激支持細胞以支持精子發育。
  • LH刺激Leydig細胞產生睪固酮，並回饋至垂體以調控睪固酮濃度。
〈易混淆提醒：FSH → 支持細胞（Sertoli）→ 支持精子發育；LH → Leydig細胞 → 產生睪固酮。兩條路徑對象與作用完全不同，是本模組 Quiz 6 第2、3、4 題共同的出題核心，務必準確配對，不可混淆「哪一種激素刺激哪一種細胞」。〉
精子生成（曲細精管、支持細胞）Spermatogenesis — Seminiferous Tubules & Sertoli Cells
English必記
  • The testes are composed of numerous thin, tightly coiled tubules known as the seminiferous tubules; sperm cells are produced within the walls of these tubules.
  • Within the tubule walls are many randomly scattered Sertoli cells, whose function is to support and nourish the immature sperm cells by giving them nutrients and blood products.
  • As the young germ cells grow, Sertoli cells help transport them from the outer surface of the seminiferous tubule to the central channel of the tubule.
  • Sperm cells are continually being produced, but not all areas of the seminiferous tubules produce sperm cells at the same time.
  • One immature germ cell takes as long as 74 days to reach final maturation, with intermittent resting phases during this growth process.
  • Once matured, sperm is transported through the long seminiferous tubules and stored in the epididymis until ready to leave the body.
  • Healthy testes produce about 1 million sperm per day.
中文必記
  • 睪丸由許多細長且高度捲曲之曲細精管組成，精子即於其管壁中生成。
  • 管壁中散布許多支持細胞（Sertoli cells），其功能為提供養分與血液成分以支持並滋養未成熟精子。
  • 當生殖細胞成長時，支持細胞協助將其從曲細精管外層移送至中央管腔。
  • 睪丸持續產生精子，但曲細精管不同區域並非同時進行精子生成。
  • 一個未成熟生殖細胞需約74天才能完全成熟，過程中會有間歇性休止期。
  • 精子成熟後，會經曲細精管運送並儲存於副睪中，直到準備離開體外。
  • 健康睪丸每天約產生一百萬個精子。

12.3精子結構、生理功能與精液分析Sperm Anatomy, Physiology & Semen Analysis

精子結構Sperm Anatomy
English

Sperm develop in the testes and consist of a head, a midpiece, and a tail.

  • The head contains the nucleus with densely coiled chromatin fibers, surrounded anteriorly by an acrosome that contains enzymes for penetrating the female egg.
  • The midpiece has a central filamentous core with many mitochondria spiraled around it.
中文

精子於睪丸中形成，由頭部、中段與尾部構成。

  • 頭部含有高度捲曲染色質纖維之細胞核，前端則為含有穿透卵子所需酶之頂體。
  • 中段具中央纖維核心，並有大量粒線體螺旋環繞其外。
精子生理與功能Sperm Physiology & Function
English
  • Most of the energy (ATP) for sperm motility is derived from the metabolism of fructose carried in the seminal fluid.
  • This takes place in the mitochondria located in the sperm's midpiece.
  • This energy is used for the journey through the female cervix, uterus, and uterine tubes.
  • Motile sperm cells typically move via flagella and require a water medium in order to swim toward the egg for fertilization.
  • These cells cannot swim backwards due to the nature of their propulsion.
  • The uniflagellated sperm cells (with one flagellum) are referred to as spermatozoa.
中文
  • 精子運動所需之大部分能量（ATP）來自精液中果糖之代謝。
  • 此過程發生於精子中段之粒線體中。
  • 此能量用於精子穿越女性子宮頸、子宮與輸卵管之旅程。
  • 具運動性之精子通常以鞭毛運動，並需在液體介質中方能游向卵子完成受精。
  • 由於推進方式之特性，精子無法向後游動。
  • 具單一鞭毛之精子細胞稱為精子（spermatozoa）。
精液分析——三項參數與正常值Semen Analysis — Three Parameters & Normal Values
English必記

Semen analysis measures 3 sperm parameters:

  • Sperm count — normal is 40 million per ejaculate.
  • Motility (ability to swim) — at least 50% forward moving.
  • Morphology (shape) — at least 30% normal.
中文必記

精液分析測量三項精子參數：

  • 精子數量——正常值為每次射精四千萬（40 million）。
  • 活動力（游動能力）——至少50%向前移動。
  • 形態（形狀）——至少30%正常。
〈考點提醒：原文對正常精子數量僅給出「每次射精40 million」單一數值作為正常門檻，並未以「20–40 million」等範圍表示；本模組 Quiz 6 第5題即針對此一細節設計是非題（見下方12.11節Q5），請留意原文措辭本身即為單一「至少40 million」之下限值，並非一段範圍。〉
English

The PPTX lecture notes (slide 6) add a TCM-correlation gloss for these three parameters that is not stated in the source PDF text:

  • Just like eggs, the number of sperm is an expression of Kidney Essence.
  • Motility has more to do with the energy, or Qi, of the sperm and its ability to have enough energy to swim.
  • Morphology is an expression of Yin and Blood — the shape of the substantial thing; morphology is influenced by nutrition, heat and infection.

  • 如同卵子一般，精子數量為腎精之表現。
  • 活動力與精子之能量（氣）較為相關，反映其游動是否具備足夠之能量。
  • 形態為陰血之表現——即實質形體本身之形狀；形態並受營養、熱邪與感染等因素影響。

12.4中醫生育力要件與心在性功能中的角色TCM Requirements for Male Fertility & the Heart's Role in Sexual Function

中醫生育力六要件Six TCM Requirements for Fertility
English必記
  • Adequate Kidney Essence — Kidney essence must be adequate: sperm and semen are the expression of Kidney essence.
  • Warm Ming Men — the Ming Men must be sufficiently warm to power the transformation of Kidney essence into semen and sperm.
  • Free flowing Liver qi — to regulate Kidney qi transformation and maintain normal ejaculatory function.
  • Adequate qi and blood — to ensure the constant cultivation of later heaven essence to support early heaven essence.
  • Free from substantial accumulations — free of obstructions such as phlegm and blood stasis so the seminal pathway is sufficiently patent to allow normal ejaculation.
  • Free from excess Heat — free of damp heat and heat toxins in the essence chamber, which may scorch and decoct the semen and damage the sperm.
中文必記
  • 腎精充足——腎精須充足：精子與精液即為腎精之表現。
  • 命門溫暖——命門須足夠溫暖，方能推動腎精轉化為精液與精子。
  • 肝氣疏通——用以調節腎氣轉化並維持正常射精功能。
  • 氣血充足——以確保後天之精持續滋養先天之精。
  • 無實質性積滯——無痰與血瘀等阻塞，以確保精道通暢以利正常射精。
  • 無過多熱邪——精室中不可有濕熱或熱毒，以免灼傷、熬煉精液並損害精子。
心在性功能中的角色The Heart's Role in Sexual Function
English必記
  • In men, the Heart plays a crucial role in erection, orgasm and ejaculation.
  • Erection and ejaculation depend on the descending of Heart-Qi.
  • To perform these functions, Heart-Qi descends to communicate with Kidney-Qi.
  • If the Minister Fire within the Kidneys is deficient, there will be decreased libido and impotence.
  • If Heart-Qi and Heart-Blood are deficient, or fail to descend to communicate with the Kidneys, there may be impotence or premature ejaculation.
中文必記
  • 在男性中，心於勃起、高潮與射精中扮演關鍵角色。
  • 勃起與射精皆有賴心氣下降。
  • 為執行此等功能，心氣下降以與腎氣溝通。
  • 若腎中相火（Minister Fire）不足，則會出現性慾下降與陽痿。
  • 若心氣與心血不足，或不能下降與腎相通，則可能出現陽痿或早洩。
〈重要：此段「相火不足→性慾下降、陽痿；心氣心血不足或不能下降交通於腎→陽痿或早洩」為原文逐字陳述，亦為本模組 Quiz 6 第12題（是非題）之出題原文，二者為並列但成因不同之兩條病機路徑——腎中相火不足是「原發於腎」，心氣心血不足或不降則是「原發於心、未能下交於腎」，考試作答時須清楚分辨陽痿／早洩之成因究竟在心抑或在腎。〉

  • Blood stasis may also arise from heat, or through trauma.

Module 12 Exam Focus 考點整理 · based on CTCMPAO question patterns

依你提供的1000題題庫（q1000，共946題）以「male infertility、sperm、spermatogenesis、varicocele、kidney yang、kidney yin、testosterone、leydig、sertoli、semen、ejaculat、ming men、minister fire、erectile、impotence、andrology、testes/testis、epididym、scrotum」等關鍵字進行程式化全文比對。廣義之「kidney yin／kidney yang」命中題數極多（逾90題），但檢視後確認絕大多數屬女性婦科證型案例（月經、帶下、水腫等），與男性生殖直接相關者相對有限；已篩選出下列與本模組男性生育力／男科內容直接相關、且原始題庫本身已標示正解之題目，作為本模組之考點整理，並非本模組原文照抄。
  • 肝腎與精子正常排泄 Liver & Kidney govern normal sperm emission（題庫Q892）：「與男性精子正常排泄有關者」正解為肝與腎（Liver and Kidney），與本模組12.4節「肝氣疏通以調節腎氣轉化並維持正常射精功能」直接呼應——肝主疏泄、腎主閉藏，兩者協調方能維持正常射精。
  • 天癸（精子／卵子）生成之關鍵 What is most important for producing Tiangui (sperm/ovum)（題庫Q923）：正解為「腎之氣精充足」（Sufficient Qi and essence of kidney），與本模組「腎精充足」要件一致；同一組另一題（Q841）則指出天癸（Tiangui）本身是「促進腎精轉化為生殖之精」的關鍵，呼應12.4節「命門溫暖以推動腎精轉化為精液與精子」之機轉。
  • 腎氣不固 vs. 本模組六大證型 Kidney Qi failing to consolidate — a pattern outside this module's six named patterns（題庫Q252、Q853）：頻繁遺精、神疲乏力、面色蒼白、舌淡苔白、脈沉弱之案例，正解為「腎氣不固」（Kidney Qi fails to consolidate），此證型並不在本模組12.5節所列六個男性不育證型之內，屬題庫中額外考查之相關但不同之獨立證型，應注意與腎陽虛（同樣可見畏寒、腰膝冷痛）相互鑑別；另一題並指出「遺精」屬於「腎氣不固」證候群之一部分，但「心悸頭暈」則不屬於此證候群，是常見的鑑別陷阱。
  • 心腎不交——與12.4節「心之角色」直接對應 Heart-Kidney disharmony — directly matches §12.4's "Role of the Heart"（題庫Q387）：性活躍男性出現腰痠、遺精、潮熱盜汗、失眠、心神不寧、健忘、頭暈耳鳴，舌紅少苔，脈沉細數，正解為「心腎不交」（Disharmony between Heart and Kidney），而非單純腎陰虛或肝腎陰虛——此題直接印證本模組12.4節「心氣不能下降與腎相通」可致性功能障礙之病機，考試常以此類案例測試「心」與「腎」兩種不同病位之鑑別。
  • 陽痿之兩種不同證型與選穴 Impotence — two different patterns, two different point prescriptions（題庫Q107、Q115）：陽痿伴面色蒼白、頭暈、四肢冷、腰膝酸軟無力、舌淡苔白、脈沉細（近似本模組腎陽虛表現）者，選穴以心俞、脾俞、腎俞、神門、三陰交、足三里、命門、太谿為正解；陽痿伴口苦、口渴、小便灼熱色深、舌黃膩苔、脈細數（近似濕熱／肝經濕熱表現）者，選穴則改為肝俞、膽俞、脾俞、胃俞、行間、太衝——兩題選穴組合完全不同，是「同一症狀（陽痿）、不同證型、不同選穴」的典型考法。
  • 陰囊腫脹＋濕熱——與血瘀證「陰囊沉重脹痛」之鑑別 Swollen scrotum with Damp-Heat — differentiate from Blood Stasis's "heaviness in scrotum"（題庫Q149）：陰囊腫脹伴沉重感、疑似疝氣，舌紅苔黃膩，脈滑數，正解為「濕熱下注」（Downward pouring of Damp-Heat），而非血瘀——本模組12.9節血瘀證雖同樣列有「陰囊沉重脹痛」之症狀，但血瘀證之舌脈為舌紫有瘀點、脈澀或沉細，與此題「舌紅苔黃膩、脈滑數」明顯不同；陰囊症狀相似但舌脈證據不同，正是鑑別診斷的關鍵，不可僅憑單一症狀（陰囊沉重）判斷證型。
  • 艾灸治療陽痿之常用穴 Moxibustion point for impotence（題庫Q821）：正解為關元（Ren 4 / Guanyuan），與本模組12.6節腎陰虛證針灸處方中亦列有CV4（關元）相呼應，關元為任脈要穴、培補元氣，多種男性生殖相關證型之針灸處方皆可見其身影。

Q1原 Quiz 6 第1題（單選題）

What is the pathway that semen travel through?

精子（精液）所經之路徑為何？

〈推測判斷，匯出畫面未揭露正解〉正解為選項B。依本模組12.1節（取自PDF原文）之路徑：睪丸→副睪（儲存）→輸精管（途中加入精囊與庫柏腺分泌物）→射精管（穿過前列腺）→尿道，選項B之順序（睪丸、副睪、輸精管、精囊、射精管、尿道）與此完全一致。選項A起點錯誤（從副睪開始，漏列睪丸）；選項C順序錯誤且漏列輸精管與射精管、尿道；選項D起點錯誤（從輸精管開始，漏列睪丸與副睪）。
〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key〉Correct answer: B. Per this module's own §12.1 (taken directly from the source PDF), the pathway is Testis → Epididymis (storage) → Vas Deferens (joined by Seminal Vesicle and Cowper's Gland secretions) → Ejaculatory Duct (through the prostate) → Urethra, exactly matching option B's sequence. Option A starts mid-pathway (omits the testis); C is out of order and omits the vas deferens/ejaculatory duct/urethra; D also omits the testis and epididymis.
Q2原 Quiz 6 第2題（單選題）

Leydig cells live in the seminiferous tubules. Which of the following does NOT apply to the function of the Leydig cells?

Leydig細胞位於曲細精管中。下列何者並非Leydig細胞之功能？

〈推測判斷，匯出畫面未揭露正解〉正解為選項D。血睪屏障（blood-testis barrier）係由支持細胞（Sertoli cells）之緊密連結所形成，並非Leydig細胞之功能；依本模組12.2節，Leydig細胞受LH刺激分泌睪固酮（選項A、B正確），而睪固酮確實有助於刺激精子生成（選項C亦正確），故僅D「形成血睪屏障」不屬於Leydig細胞功能。〈附帶說明：本題題幹本身敘述「Leydig細胞位於曲細精管中」，嚴格而言略有不精確——Leydig細胞實際位於曲細精管之間的間質組織（interstitial tissue）中，而非管壁或管腔內；本模組不修改原始題幹文字，僅在此誠實註記此一解剖學細節，供讀者留意，但不影響本題「何者非其功能」之作答邏輯。〉
〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key〉Correct answer: D. The blood-testis barrier is formed by Sertoli cells' tight junctions, not by Leydig cells. Per §12.2, Leydig cells are stimulated by LH to secrete testosterone (A, B correct), and testosterone does stimulate spermatogenesis (C correct), so only D does not apply to Leydig cells. Note: the question stem's premise that "Leydig cells live in the seminiferous tubules" is itself imprecise — Leydig cells actually sit in the interstitial tissue between the tubules, not within their walls or lumen. This is flagged honestly without altering the original question text, and does not change the logic of this "which does NOT apply" item.
Q3原 Quiz 6 第3題（是非題）

是非題：「FSH刺激Leydig細胞產生睪固酮。」此敘述正確嗎？

〈推測判斷，匯出畫面未揭露正解〉正解為「錯誤（False）」。依本模組12.2節原文：FSH刺激支持細胞（Sertoli cells）促進精子生成，LH才是刺激Leydig細胞產生睪固酮之激素——本題刻意將FSH與LH兩者之目標細胞互換，是典型的混淆設陷考法，與Q2、Q4共同構成本模組針對「FSH／LH分別作用於哪種細胞」之重點測驗組。
〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key〉Correct answer: False. Per §12.2, FSH stimulates Sertoli cells to support sperm production; it is LH that stimulates Leydig cells to produce testosterone. This item deliberately swaps FSH and LH's target cells — a classic mix-up, forming a matched trio with Q2 and Q4 testing exactly this FSH/LH-to-cell-type mapping.
Q4原 Quiz 6 第4題（單選題）

What are Sertoli cells and what are their function?

支持細胞（Sertoli cells）是什麼，其功能為何？

〈推測判斷，匯出畫面未揭露正解，本題四個選項皆非完美對應原文用語，已依最佳擬合原則判斷〉正解判定為選項D。依本模組12.2節原文，支持細胞之功能是「提供養分與血液成分以支持並滋養未成熟精子細胞」，四個選項中D「提供養分進入通道」與此描述最為接近。選項A描述的其實是HPT軸整體，而非支持細胞本身；選項B描述的是副睪內精子成熟之過程，屬於不同解剖部位／不同機轉；選項C「分泌睪固酮等性荷爾蒙」實際上是Leydig細胞之功能，並非支持細胞——此為本題最主要之混淆陷阱。
〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key; none of the four options is a perfect verbatim match, judged by best fit〉Correct answer judged as D. Per §12.2, Sertoli cells' function is to "support and nourish the immature sperm cells by giving them nutrients and blood products" — of the four options, D ("provide an entry gate for nutrients") is the closest match. Option A actually describes the HPT axis as a whole, not Sertoli cells specifically; B describes epididymal maturation, a different process/location; C ("endocrine cells generating sex hormones like testosterone") actually describes Leydig cells, not Sertoli cells — this is the main distractor trap.
Q5原 Quiz 6 第5題（是非題）

True or False? "A healthy testes will produce 1 million sperm everyday and normal ejaculate will contain 20-40 million sperm."

是非題：「健康睪丸每天會產生一百萬個精子，且正常一次射精含有20–40百萬個精子。」此敘述正確嗎？

〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key; this judgment turns on a subtle numeric-wording distinction, reasoning disclosed in full〉Judged False. The first half ("1 million sperm per day") matches §12.2 exactly. But the second half claims a "20-40 million" range, while §12.3's source text states a single floor value — "40 million per ejaculate" — meaning "at least 40 million," not a range starting at 20 million. Restating a single minimum as a range that includes a lower value not stated in the source makes the sentence inconsistent with this module's own wording, so the statement as a whole is judged False. (Standard reproductive-medicine reference ranges, e.g. WHO's ~39 million total-sperm lower reference limit, likewise support a single floor rather than a "20" floor, though this module's own PDF wording is the primary basis for this judgment.)

Q8原 Quiz 6 第8題（單選案例題）

Don，35歲，嘗試懷孕中；其妻先前一次妊娠於接近足月時胎死腹中，此後2年未再懷孕。精液分析顯示精子數量極低、異常率高、活動力差（「三重異常」），睪固酮偏低，已建議進行IVF＋ICSI。主訴性慾低下、精力低（冬季加重）、手腳冰冷、比一般人怕冷、腰痛、頻尿、花粉症、無法耐受重口味／辛辣食物、情緒低落、注意力不集中。舌：淡、白苔。脈：軟。Don之中醫診斷為何？

〈Inferred — the export reveals no answer key〉Correct: B, Kidney Yang Deficiency. Per §12.7, aversion to cold (especially more than others), cold/aching low back, low libido, fatigue, frequent urination, and a pale tongue with moist coating / weak fine pulse all map onto this pattern's own S&S and tongue/pulse list; the case's winter-worsening and cold extremities also fit Yang deficiency's core "failure to warm" mechanism. Option A (Spleen Yang Deficiency) can also show cold aversion and fatigue, but its core presentation centers on poor appetite, loose stools and abdominal distension — none mentioned here. Option C (Cold Stagnation) centers on testicular/lower-abdominal distending pain, not mentioned, and has no frequent-urination or low-libido symptoms in the source. Option D (Qi and Blood Deficiency) is named only in the source with no detail to compare against, making it the weakest fit.
Q9-A原 Quiz 6 第9題（單選案例題，方劑）

For Don's case (above), what is the best herbal prescription?

依Don之案例（見上題），最適合之方劑組合為何？

〈本次追加複查更新——不再是推測判斷：此案例題正解C（五子衍宗丸＋右歸丸）已由簡報檔（PPTX）第16–17張投影片直接、逐字證實為腎陽虛證之官方方劑，並同步收錄於本模組12.7節；以下推理過程予以保留，作為理解Q8/Q9案例邏輯之輔助說明〉正解為C。Q8已判定Don為腎陽虛，故方劑須能補腎陽。五子衍宗丸為補精之經典方劑，無論陰虛或陽虛皆可能使用，故選項B與C之鑑別關鍵在於配對之第二味方劑：右歸丸專補腎陽，左歸丸則專補腎陰——與Don之陽虛診斷相符者為右歸丸，故答案為C而非B。選項A之十全大補湯偏重氣血雙補而非專攻腎陽；選項D暖肝煎為溫肝散寒之方，主治肝經寒滯（如疝氣、少腹冷痛），並非以補腎陽為核心，與本案例畏寒、腰痛、性慾低下等腎陽虛主症不完全對應。
〈This follow-up review confirms this is no longer inferred: correct answer C (Wu Zi Yan Zong Wan + You Gui Wan) is directly confirmed verbatim in the PPTX speaker-note transcript (slides 16–17) as this pattern's own official formula, now also recorded in §12.7; the reasoning below is retained as supporting explanation of the Q8/Q9 case logic〉Correct: C. Q8 established Don's pattern as Kidney Yang Deficiency, so the formula must tonify Kidney Yang. Wu Zi Yan Zong Wan is a classic Essence-tonifying formula usable in either a Yin- or Yang-leaning case, so options B and C are differentiated by their paired second formula: You Gui Wan specifically tonifies Kidney Yang, while Zuo Gui Wan specifically tonifies Kidney Yin — matching Don's Yang-deficiency diagnosis is You Gui Wan, hence C, not B. Option A's Shi Quan Da Bu Tang tonifies Qi and Blood broadly rather than targeting Kidney Yang specifically; option D's Nuan Gan Jian warms the Liver channel and disperses cold (e.g. for hernia, cold lower-abdominal pain) rather than centering on Kidney Yang tonification, an imperfect fit for this case's core cold-aversion/low-back-pain/low-libido presentation.
Q9-B補充推理題（依上題邏輯延伸，非原始題目）

Of the two formulas offered in Q9 (You Gui Wan / Zuo Gui Wan), which one specifically tonifies Kidney Yang — making it the correct pairing for a Kidney Yang Deficiency case like Don's?

上題（Q9）所提供之兩個方劑（右歸丸／左歸丸）中，何者專門補腎陽——因而成為Don此類腎陽虛案例之正確配對？

〈本題為本模組依標準中醫方劑學知識自行設計之補充練習題，用以清楚呈現Q9推理邏輯，並非Quiz 6原始題目〉正解為B，右歸丸。右歸丸（張景岳方）以補腎陽、益精血、溫補命門為主；左歸丸則以滋補腎陰、填精益髓為主——兩方藥味組成近似（皆含熟地、山藥、山萸肉、枸杞等），但右歸丸加入肉桂、附子、杜仲等溫陽藥，左歸丸則加入龜板膠等滋陰藥，是中醫方劑學中「陰陽雙向配對」之經典範例，亦是Q9鑑別選項B、C之核心依據。
〈This is a supplementary item designed by this module using standard TCM formulary knowledge to make Q9's reasoning explicit — not an original Quiz 6 question〉Correct: B, You Gui Wan. You Gui Wan (Zhang Jingyue) tonifies Kidney Yang, boosts Essence and Blood, and warms Ming Men; Zuo Gui Wan instead nourishes Kidney Yin and replenishes Essence/Marrow. The two formulas share a similar herbal base (Shu Di Huang, Shan Yao, Shan Zhu Yu, Gou Qi Zi) but You Gui Wan adds warming herbs (Rou Gui, Fu Zi, Du Zhong) while Zuo Gui Wan adds Yin-nourishing ones (Gui Ban Jiao) — a classic Yin/Yang paired-formula pair, and the basis for differentiating Q9's options B and C.

Q11原 Quiz 6 第11題（申論改寫）

What is a varicocele and how does it impact fertility?

何謂精索靜脈曲張（varicocele）？其如何影響生育力？

〈原始「Answer」欄位所示之申論作答內容，經核對後與本模組12.9節血瘀證症狀列表（「精索靜脈曲張」一項）相符，已改寫為單選題形式，正解逐字取自原始作答內容〉正解為A，逐字取自「Answer」欄位所示內容：靜脈曲張擴大使睪丸溫度升高、降低精子生成量，導致生育力下降。此定義亦與本模組12.9節血瘀證症狀列表中之「精索靜脈曲張」一項相互印證——臨床上精索靜脈曲張確實常歸屬中醫血瘀證之範疇。選項B、C、D皆為依解剖與生理邏輯設計之合理干擾選項，分別描述完全不同之病理機轉（機械性阻塞、感染、內分泌失衡），與精索靜脈曲張「靜脈曲張→局部升溫→影響精子生成」之機轉不符。
〈The raw essay "Answer" was checked against this module's own §12.9 Blood Stasis S&S list (which itself lists "varicocele") and rewritten as a multiple-choice item, with the correct option taken verbatim from the original submitted answer〉Correct: A, taken verbatim from the "Answer" field: enlarged veins raise testicular temperature and reduce sperm production, causing decreased fertility. This definition also corroborates §12.9's Blood Stasis S&S list, which itself lists "varicocele" as a symptom — clinically, varicocele is indeed often categorized under the TCM Blood Stasis pattern. Options B, C and D are reasonable distractors built on anatomy/physiology logic, each describing a different mechanism (mechanical blockage, infection, endocrine imbalance) that does not match varicocele's actual "dilated veins → local heat → impaired sperm production" mechanism.
